```{r}
# ============================================================================
# Robust Feature Transformation (auto-detect features & safe to run)
# - Will use data_clean if exists, else data_work, else data_raw
# - Handles salary_range, repaid_loan_on_prev_car, repaid (target),
#   numeric outlier checks for standard numeric variables,
#   plus added handling for driver_tenure and size_of_downpayment
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== Feature Transformation (robust, auto-detect) ===\n")

# --- pick source dataframe ---
if (exists("data_clean")) {
  data_transformed <- data_clean
  cat("Using 'data_clean' as source.\n")
} else if (exists("data_work")) {
  data_transformed <- data_work
  cat("Using 'data_work' as source.\n")
} else if (exists("data_raw")) {
  data_transformed <- data_raw
  cat("Using 'data_raw' as source.\n")
} else {
  stop("No input dataset found. Please create one of: data_clean, data_work, data_raw.")
}

n_before <- nrow(data_transformed)

# -----------------------------
# 1) Robust salary_range mapping
# -----------------------------
if ("salary_range" %in% colnames(data_transformed)) {
  cat("\n1) Converting salary_range to ordered factor (robust)...\n")
  
  map_salary_to_level <- function(x) {
    if(is.na(x) || trimws(as.character(x)) == "") return(NA_integer_)
    s <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
    s2 <- gsub("€", "", s, fixed = TRUE)
    s2 <- gsub("\\s+", " ", s2)
    s2 <- gsub("[^0-9kK+ \\-]", "", s2)
    s2 <- trimws(s2)
    
    # direct patterns
    if(grepl("60\\+|60k\\+|>=60|>= 60|60k\\s*\\+", s2, ignore.case = TRUE)) return(4L)
    if(grepl("40.*-.*60|40k.*-.*60k|40.*-.*60k|40k.*-.*60", s2, ignore.case = TRUE)) return(3L)
    if(grepl("20.*-.*40|20k.*-.*40k|20.*-.*40k|20k.*-.*40", s2, ignore.case = TRUE)) return(2L)
    if(grepl("0.*-.*20|0-20|<20|< 20|under 20|less than 20|0k.*-.*20k", s2, ignore.case = TRUE)) return(1L)
    
    # fallback: extract first number and use thresholds
    nums <- unlist(regmatches(s2, gregexpr("[0-9]+", s2)))
    if(length(nums) > 0) {
      n <- as.numeric(nums[1])
      if(!is.na(n)) {
        if(n >= 60) return(4L)
        if(n >= 40) return(3L)
        if(n >= 20) return(2L)
        return(1L)
      }
    }
    # else unknown
    return(NA_integer_)
  }
  
  # keep original raw column for debugging if not already kept
  if (!("salary_range_raw" %in% colnames(data_transformed))) {
    data_transformed$salary_range_raw <- data_transformed$salary_range
  }
  # apply mapping safely
  data_transformed$salary_range_level <- vapply(data_transformed$salary_range_raw, map_salary_to_level, integer(1))
  salary_labels <- c("0-20K", "20-40K", "40-60K", "60K+")
  data_transformed$salary_range <- factor(data_transformed$salary_range_level,
                                          levels = 1:4,
                                          labels = salary_labels,
                                          ordered = TRUE)
  
  cat("   Salary range distribution (after mapping):\n")
  print(table(data_transformed$salary_range, useNA = "ifany"))
  
  # show rows that failed mapping (optional)
  bad_sr_idx <- which(is.na(data_transformed$salary_range_level) & !is.na(data_transformed$salary_range_raw))
  if(length(bad_sr_idx) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("\n   Warning: %d rows had unmapped salary_range values. Showing up to 10 unique raw examples:\n", length(bad_sr_idx)))
    print(unique(head(data_transformed$salary_range_raw[bad_sr_idx], 10)))
  }
} else {
  cat("\n1) salary_range not found — skipping salary mapping.\n")
}

# -----------------------------
# 2) repaid_loan_on_prev_car -> binary 0/1
# -----------------------------
if ("repaid_loan_on_prev_car" %in% colnames(data_transformed)) {
  cat("\n2) Converting repaid_loan_on_prev_car to binary (0/1)...\n")
  convert_to_binary <- function(x) {
    if(is.na(x)) return(NA_integer_)
    if(is.logical(x)) return(as.integer(x))
    sx <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
    if(sx %in% c("true","t","yes","y","1")) return(1L)
    if(sx %in% c("false","f","no","n","0")) return(0L)
    if(grepl("^[0-9]+$", sx)) {
      v <- as.numeric(sx)
      return(as.integer(ifelse(v == 0, 0, 1)))
    }
    return(NA_integer_)
  }
  data_transformed$repaid_loan_on_prev_car <- vapply(data_transformed$repaid_loan_on_prev_car, convert_to_binary, integer(1))
  cat("   Previous loan repayment distribution:\n")
  print(table(data_transformed$repaid_loan_on_prev_car, useNA = "ifany"))
} else {
  cat("\n2) repaid_loan_on_prev_car not found — skipping conversion.\n")
}

# -----------------------------
# 3) Target variable 'repaid' -> factor
# -----------------------------
if ("repaid" %in% colnames(data_transformed)) {
  cat("\n3) Normalizing target variable 'repaid' to factor...\n")
  if(is.numeric(data_transformed$repaid) || is.integer(data_transformed$repaid)) {
    data_transformed$repaid <- factor(ifelse(data_transformed$repaid == 1, "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"),
                                     levels = c("Not_Repaid", "Repaid"))
  } else {
    tmp <- tolower(trimws(as.character(data_transformed$repaid)))
    data_transformed$repaid <- factor(ifelse(tmp %in% c("1","repaid","yes","y","true"), "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"),
                                     levels = c("Not_Repaid", "Repaid"))
  }
  cat("   Target distribution:\n")
  print(table(data_transformed$repaid, useNA = "ifany"))
  cat(sprintf("   Repayment rate: %.2f%%\n", mean(data_transformed$repaid == "Repaid", na.rm = TRUE) * 100))
} else {
  cat("\n3) Target 'repaid' not found — skipping target normalization.\n")
}

# -----------------------------
# 4) driver_tenure (new) -> numeric years
#    Attempts to parse common formats:
#      '5 years', '5y', '60 months', '5-7', '5+', '5 yrs', '0.5', '6 months'
# -----------------------------
if ("driver_tenure" %in% colnames(data_transformed)) {
  cat("\n4) Parsing driver_tenure into numeric years (driver_tenure_years)...\n")
  parse_tenure_to_years <- function(x) {
    if (is.na(x) || trimws(as.character(x)) == "") return(NA_real_)
    s <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
    s <- gsub(",", ".", s, fixed = TRUE)
    # handle ranges like "5-7" -> take lower bound
    s <- gsub("\\s*[-–—]\\s*", "-", s)
    # extract first number (may be integer or decimal)
    num_match <- regmatches(s, regexpr("[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?", s))
    if (length(num_match) == 0 || num_match == "") return(NA_real_)
    n <- as.numeric(num_match)
    if (is.na(n)) return(NA_real_)
    # detect months
    if (grepl("month|mo\\b|mths|mth", s)) {
      return(n / 12)
    }
    # detect explicit 'year' or 'yr'
    if (grepl("year|yr|yrs", s)) return(n)
    # if value looks like months given as number > 12 treat as months (heuristic)
    if (n > 12 && !grepl("\\.", num_match)) {
      # treat as months
      return(n / 12)
    }
    # otherwise assume already in years
    return(n)
  }
  data_transformed$driver_tenure_years <- vapply(data_transformed$driver_tenure, parse_tenure_to_years, numeric(1))
  # keep numeric version; optionally convert original to factor/categorized if desired
  cat("   driver_tenure_years summary:\n")
  print(summary(data_transformed$driver_tenure_years))
} else {
  cat("\n4) driver_tenure not found — skipping tenure parsing.\n")
}

# -----------------------------
# 5) size_of_downpayment (new) -> numeric amount or percent
#    Heuristics: if contains '%' -> percent (0-100); else parse currency (k -> *1000)
# -----------------------------
if ("size_of_downpayment" %in% colnames(data_transformed)) {
  cat("\n5) Parsing size_of_downpayment into numeric_downpayment and downpayment_percent (if applicable)...\n")
  parse_downpayment <- function(x) {
    if (is.na(x) || trimws(as.character(x)) == "") return(list(amount = NA_real_, percent = NA_real_))
    s <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
    # percent
    if (grepl("%", s)) {
      num <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9\\.\\,]", "", s))
      if (!is.na(num)) return(list(amount = NA_real_, percent = num))
      return(list(amount = NA_real_, percent = NA_real_))
    }
    # remove currency symbols and spaces
    s2 <- gsub("[€$£,]", "", s)
    s2 <- gsub("\\s+", "", s2)
    # support 'k' notation
    if (grepl("k\\b", s2)) {
      n <- as.numeric(gsub("k", "", s2))
      if (!is.na(n)) return(list(amount = n * 1000, percent = NA_real_))
    }
    # numeric plain
    n <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9\\.]", "", s2))
    if (!is.na(n)) return(list(amount = n, percent = NA_real_))
    return(list(amount = NA_real_, percent = NA_real_))
  }
  parsed <- lapply(data_transformed$size_of_downpayment, parse_downpayment)
  parsed_amount <- vapply(parsed, `[[`, numeric(1), "amount")
  parsed_percent <- vapply(parsed, `[[`, numeric(1), "percent")
  data_transformed$downpayment_amount <- parsed_amount
  data_transformed$downpayment_percent <- parsed_percent
  cat("   downpayment_amount summary:\n")
  print(summary(data_transformed$downpayment_amount))
  cat("   downpayment_percent summary:\n")
  print(summary(data_transformed$downpayment_percent))
} else {
  cat("\n5) size_of_downpayment not found — skipping downpayment parsing.\n")
}

# -----------------------------
# 6) Ensure numeric types for numerical features & outlier detection
# -----------------------------
cat("\n6) Outlier detection for numerical variables...\n")
# default numerical vars to check; only check those that exist
numerical_vars <- c("car_value", "debt_to_income_ratio", "loan_length", 
                    "driver_tenure_years", "downpayment_amount", "downpayment_percent")

for(var in numerical_vars) {
  if(!var %in% colnames(data_transformed)) {
    cat(sprintf("   - %s not found in data, skipping.\n", var)); next
  }
  vec <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(data_transformed[[var]]))
  if (all(is.na(vec))) {
    cat(sprintf("   - %s contains only NA (or non-numeric after coercion), skipping.\n", var)); next
  }
  q1 <- quantile(vec, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  q3 <- quantile(vec, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  iqr <- q3 - q1
  lower_bound <- q1 - 1.5 * iqr
  upper_bound <- q3 + 1.5 * iqr
  outliers <- sum(vec < lower_bound | vec > upper_bound, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("   %s: %d outliers (%.2f%%)\n",
              var, outliers, outliers / nrow(data_transformed) * 100))
}

cat("\n✓ Feature transformation complete\n")
cat(sprintf("Rows before/after: %d / %d\n", n_before, nrow(data_transformed)))


```


```{r}
# ============================================================================
# Feature Scaling (Robust, Auto-detect numeric variables)
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== Feature Scaling (robust version) ===\n")

# Work on a copy
data_scaled <- data_transformed

# Automatically detect numeric columns (excluding target)
numeric_cols <- names(data_scaled)[sapply(data_scaled, is.numeric)]

# Optional: remove target variable if encoded as numeric (just in case)
numeric_cols <- setdiff(numeric_cols, "repaid")

cat("\nNumeric columns detected for scaling:\n")
print(numeric_cols)

# Store scaling parameters
scaling_params <- list()

if (length(numeric_cols) == 0) {
  cat("\n⚠️ No numeric columns detected — skipping scaling.\n")
} else {
  cat("\nScaling numerical features:\n")

  for(col in numeric_cols) {
    vec <- data_scaled[[col]]

    # skip columns that are all NA or constant
    if (all(is.na(vec))) {
      cat(sprintf("  - %s skipped (all values are NA)\n", col))
      next
    }
    if (sd(vec, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
      cat(sprintf("  - %s skipped (standard deviation = 0; constant column)\n", col))
      next
    }

    # Calculate mean and sd
    col_mean <- mean(vec, na.rm = TRUE)
    col_sd <- sd(vec, na.rm = TRUE)

    scaling_params[[col]] <- list(mean = col_mean, sd = col_sd)

    # Apply scaling
    data_scaled[[col]] <- (vec - col_mean) / col_sd

    cat(sprintf("  %s: mean=%.4f, sd=%.4f\n", col_mean, col_sd, col_sd))
  }
}

cat("\n✓ Feature scaling complete\n")
```

5. Model Training
5.1 Logistic Regression

```{r}
# STEP5_logistic_regression_fixed_v2.R
# Robust Logistic Regression step (caret::glm)
# - Accepts existing train_data/test_data OR auto-creates them from available dataset
# - Adds stratified split, robust coercion & alignment
# - CV configurable (default: repeatedcv, 10 folds x 3 repeats)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(caret)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(pROC)
  library(ggplot2)
})

set.seed(42)

# ---------------------------
# CONFIG (change these if desired)
# ---------------------------
OUT_DIR <- file.path(getwd(), "model_lr_outputs")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

SPLIT_PROP <- 0.70    # proportion for training set when auto-splitting (changed to 70%)
CV_METHOD  <- "repeatedcv"   # "cv" or "repeatedcv"
CV_FOLDS   <- 10             # number of folds
CV_REPEATS <- 3              # only used when CV_METHOD == "repeatedcv"
# ---------------------------

# === Helper: find a source dataset if train/test missing ===
find_source_dataset <- function() {
  candidates <- c("data_transformed","data_scaled","data_work","data_clean","data_raw","data")
  for (nm in candidates) {
    if (exists(nm)) {
      message("Found source dataset: ", nm)
      return(get(nm))
    }
  }
  return(NULL)
}

# === Helper: coerce response to character labels "Not_Repaid"/"Repaid" safely ===
coerce_response_char <- function(v) {
  vc <- as.character(v)
  vc[is.na(vc)] <- NA_character_
  idx <- which(!is.na(vc))
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(vc)
  lc <- tolower(trimws(vc[idx]))
  lc[lc %in% c("0","false","no","n","notrepaid","not_repaid","not repaid","nope")] <- "Not_Repaid"
  lc[lc %in% c("1","true","yes","y","repaid","paid","ok","paid")] <- "Repaid"
  vc[idx] <- lc
  return(vc)
}

# === Ensure train_data/test_data exist or create them from a source ===
if (!exists("train_data") || !exists("test_data")) {
  src <- find_source_dataset()
  if (is.null(src)) {
    stop("train_data and test_data not found and no source dataset (data_transformed/data_scaled/data_work/data_clean/data_raw/data) available. Please provide data.")
  }
  # ensure 'repaid' exists in source
  if (!"repaid" %in% names(src)) stop("Source dataset does not contain 'repaid' column. Please ensure target exists.")
  message("Creating stratified train/test split from source dataset (prop = ", SPLIT_PROP, ")")
  tmp <- src
  tmp$.__repaid_coerced <- coerce_response_char(tmp$repaid)
  # warn if many NAs in target (they will be excluded from stratification but kept in test if desired)
  n_na_target <- sum(is.na(tmp$.__repaid_coerced))
  if (n_na_target > 0) {
    message(sprintf("Note: %d rows have NA/unknown 'repaid' after coercion; these will be excluded from stratified splitting (kept aside).", n_na_target))
  }
  # rows eligible for stratified sampling: non-NA coerced labels
  eligible_idx <- which(!is.na(tmp$.__repaid_coerced))
  if (length(eligible_idx) < 10) stop("Not enough labeled rows for stratified split. Need more labeled examples in 'repaid'.")
  # create partition
  train_idx <- createDataPartition(tmp$.__repaid_coerced[eligible_idx], p = SPLIT_PROP, list = FALSE)
  train_rows <- eligible_idx[train_idx]
  test_rows  <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(tmp)), train_rows)  # include unlabeled rows in test set
  train_data <- tmp[train_rows, , drop = FALSE]
  test_data  <- tmp[test_rows,  , drop = FALSE]
  # drop helper column (we'll coerce again later)
  train_data$.__repaid_coerced <- NULL
  test_data$.__repaid_coerced  <- NULL
  message(sprintf("Created train (%d rows) / test (%d rows)", nrow(train_data), nrow(test_data)))
} else {
  message("Using existing train_data and test_data from environment.")
}

# === Basic prechecks ===
if (!"repaid" %in% names(train_data)) stop("'train_data' must contain a 'repaid' column.")
if (!"repaid" %in% names(test_data))  message("'test_data' does not contain 'repaid' column (allowed)")

# === Coerce/truncate/clean response ===
# For train: enforce two classes and factor levels
train_data$repaid <- coerce_response_char(train_data$repaid)
unique_train_labels <- unique(na.omit(train_data$repaid))
if (length(unique_train_labels) < 2) {
  stop("After coercion, training response does not contain two classes. Found: ", paste(unique_train_labels, collapse = ", "))
}
# force factor with canonical levels
train_data$repaid <- factor(ifelse(train_data$repaid == "Repaid", "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"),
                            levels = c("Not_Repaid", "Repaid"))

# For test: coerce to same canonical char labels but keep NA if unknown
if ("repaid" %in% names(test_data)) {
  test_data$repaid <- coerce_response_char(test_data$repaid)
  # don't force factor now; will align later with train levels
}

# === Impute and align predictors ===
# Numeric median impute from train -> apply to test
num_cols <- names(train_data)[sapply(train_data, is.numeric)]
num_cols <- setdiff(num_cols, "repaid")
medians <- list()
for (cn in num_cols) {
  med <- median(train_data[[cn]], na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.na(med)) med <- 0
  medians[[cn]] <- med
  train_data[[cn]][is.na(train_data[[cn]])] <- med
  if (cn %in% names(test_data) && is.numeric(test_data[[cn]])) {
    test_data[[cn]][is.na(test_data[[cn]])] <- med
  }
}

# Categorical: fill NA -> "Missing" and align levels (train -> test)
cat_cols <- names(train_data)[sapply(train_data, function(x) is.factor(x) || is.character(x))]
cat_cols <- setdiff(cat_cols, "repaid")
for (cn in cat_cols) {
  train_data[[cn]] <- as.character(train_data[[cn]])
  train_data[[cn]][is.na(train_data[[cn]])] <- "Missing"
  train_levels <- unique(train_data[[cn]])
  train_levels <- c(setdiff(train_levels, "Missing"), "Missing")
  train_data[[cn]] <- factor(train_data[[cn]], levels = train_levels)
  if (cn %in% names(test_data)) {
    test_data[[cn]] <- as.character(test_data[[cn]])
    test_data[[cn]][is.na(test_data[[cn]])] <- "Missing"
    unseen <- setdiff(unique(test_data[[cn]]), train_levels)
    final_levels <- c(train_levels, setdiff(unseen, "Missing"))
    test_data[[cn]] <- factor(test_data[[cn]], levels = final_levels)
  }
}

# === Remove single-level predictors (in train) ===
predictors <- setdiff(names(train_data), "repaid")
single_level_cols <- c()
for (p in predictors) {
  uvals <- unique(na.omit(as.character(train_data[[p]])))
  if (length(uvals) <= 1) single_level_cols <- c(single_level_cols, p)
}
if (length(single_level_cols) > 0) {
  message("Removing single-level predictors: ", paste(single_level_cols, collapse = ", "))
  predictors <- setdiff(predictors, single_level_cols)
  train_data <- train_data[, c(predictors, "repaid"), drop = FALSE]
  # align test as well (keep columns present)
  test_preds <- intersect(names(test_data), predictors)
  test_data  <- test_data[, c(test_preds, "repaid"), drop = FALSE]
}

# Recompute predictors & num/cat
predictors <- setdiff(names(train_data), "repaid")
if (length(predictors) == 0) stop("No predictors available after pruning.")
num_cols <- predictors[sapply(train_data[predictors], is.numeric)]
cat_cols <- setdiff(predictors, num_cols)

# === Create design matrix via dummyVars (fullRank=TRUE) ===
formula_str <- paste("~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "))
dv <- dummyVars(formula_str, data = train_data, fullRank = TRUE)

train_x <- predict(dv, newdata = train_data)
test_x  <- predict(dv, newdata = test_data)

train_lr_df <- as.data.frame(train_x, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
train_lr_df$repaid <- train_data$repaid

test_lr_df <- as.data.frame(test_x, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if ("repaid" %in% names(test_data)) {
  test_lr_df$repaid <- factor(ifelse(test_data$repaid == "Repaid", "Repaid", 
                                     ifelse(test_data$repaid == "Not_Repaid","Not_Repaid", NA)),
                              levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
}

# === Remove near-zero-variance predictors ===
nzv <- nearZeroVar(train_lr_df %>% select(-repaid), saveMetrics = TRUE)
if (any(nzv$nzv)) {
  drop_cols <- rownames(nzv)[nzv$nzv]
  message("Dropping near-zero-variance columns: ", paste(drop_cols, collapse = ", "))
  train_lr_df <- train_lr_df %>% select(-all_of(drop_cols))
  test_lr_df  <- test_lr_df  %>% select(-all_of(drop_cols))
}

# Ensure no NA remain in train predictors
if (any(is.na(train_lr_df))) {
  na_counts <- colSums(is.na(train_lr_df))
  na_cols <- names(na_counts)[na_counts > 0]
  stop("NA values remain in train design matrix (cols): ", paste(na_cols, collapse = ", "),
       "\nPlease inspect imputation.")
}

# === trainControl and train model (UPDATED: repeated CV default) ===
train_control <- trainControl(
  method = CV_METHOD,
  number = CV_FOLDS,
  repeats = ifelse(CV_METHOD == "repeatedcv", CV_REPEATS, NA),
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
  savePredictions = "final",
  verboseIter = FALSE
)

message(sprintf("\nTraining Logistic Regression with %s (folds=%d, repeats=%s) (metric = ROC)...",
                CV_METHOD, CV_FOLDS, ifelse(CV_METHOD == "repeatedcv", CV_REPEATS, "NA")))
set.seed(42)
lr_fit <- tryCatch({
  train(repaid ~ ., data = train_lr_df,
        method = "glm",
        family = "binomial",
        trControl = train_control,
        metric = "ROC",
        preProcess = c("center", "scale"))
}, error = function(e) {
  stop("Training failed: ", e$message)
})

# === Outputs ===
message("\n=== Logistic Regression Summary (final glm) ===")
print(summary(lr_fit$finalModel))

message("\n=== CV Results ===")
print(lr_fit$results)

# VarImp
message("\n=== Variable importance (top 20) ===")
vi <- tryCatch(varImp(lr_fit, scale = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(vi)) {
  vi_df <- as.data.frame(vi$importance)
  vi_df$Feature <- rownames(vi_df)
  vi_df <- vi_df %>% arrange(desc(Overall))
  print(head(vi_df, 20))
  write.csv(vi_df, file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_varimp.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  message("varImp not available for this model.")
}

# === Predictions on test set ===
message("\nPredicting on test set...")
lr_pred_prob <- predict(lr_fit, newdata = test_lr_df, type = "prob")
lr_pred_class <- predict(lr_fit, newdata = test_lr_df, type = "raw")

# Evaluation (if test actuals available)
if ("repaid" %in% names(test_lr_df) && !all(is.na(test_lr_df$repaid))) {
  actual_test <- test_lr_df$repaid
  cm <- confusionMatrix(lr_pred_class, actual_test, positive = "Repaid")
  message("\n=== Test set performance ===")
  cat(sprintf("Accuracy:  %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm$overall["Accuracy"])))
  cat(sprintf("Sensitivity: %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"])))
  cat(sprintf("Specificity: %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm$byClass["Specificity"])))
  cat(sprintf("Precision: %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm$byClass["Precision"])))
  cat(sprintf("F1: %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm$byClass["F1"])))
  # ROC / AUC
  prob_vec <- NULL
  if (is.data.frame(lr_pred_prob) && "Repaid" %in% colnames(lr_pred_prob)) {
    prob_vec <- as.numeric(lr_pred_prob[,"Repaid"])
  }
  if (!is.null(prob_vec) && length(prob_vec) == length(actual_test)) {
    roc_obj <- tryCatch(roc(response = as.numeric(actual_test == "Repaid"), predictor = prob_vec, quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(roc_obj)) {
      auc_val <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
      cat(sprintf("ROC-AUC: %.6f\n", auc_val))
      png(file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_roc.png"), width = 800, height = 600)
      plot(roc_obj, main = sprintf("Logistic Regression ROC (AUC=%.4f)", auc_val))
      dev.off()
    }
  }
  message("\nConfusion matrix:")
  print(cm$table)
} else {
  message("No test labels available to compute performance metrics.")
}

# === Save artifacts ===
message("\nSaving artifacts...")
saveRDS(lr_fit, file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_fit_caret.rds"))
pred_df <- data.frame(pred_class = as.character(lr_pred_class),
                      prob_Repaid = if (is.data.frame(lr_pred_prob) && "Repaid" %in% colnames(lr_pred_prob)) as.numeric(lr_pred_prob[,"Repaid"]) else NA,
                      actual = if ("repaid" %in% names(test_lr_df)) as.character(test_lr_df$repaid) else NA,
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
write.csv(pred_df, file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_test_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
message("Saved model and predictions to: ", normalizePath(OUT_DIR))

message("\nSTEP 5 (Logistic Regression) complete.")

# ---------------------------
# Print & save TRAIN set results
# ---------------------------

OUT_DIR <- file.path(getwd(), "model_lr_outputs")
if (!dir.exists(OUT_DIR)) dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE)

# Basic checks
if (!exists("lr_fit")) stop("lr_fit not found. Run training first.")
if (!exists("train_lr_df")) stop("train_lr_df not found. Ensure the training design matrix exists.")

# Generate predictions on train set if not already present
train_pred_class <- NULL
train_pred_prob  <- NULL
try({
  train_pred_prob  <- predict(lr_fit, newdata = train_lr_df, type = "prob")
  train_pred_class <- predict(lr_fit, newdata = train_lr_df, type = "raw")
}, silent = TRUE)

if (is.null(train_pred_class) || is.null(train_pred_prob)) {
  stop("Could not produce predictions on training set (predict returned NULL). Check lr_fit and train_lr_df compatibility.")
}

# Prepare probability vector for positive class "Repaid"
prob_train_vec <- NA_real_
if (is.data.frame(train_pred_prob) && "Repaid" %in% colnames(train_pred_prob)) {
  prob_train_vec <- as.numeric(train_pred_prob[ , "Repaid"])
} else if (is.numeric(train_pred_prob) && length(train_pred_prob) == nrow(train_lr_df)) {
  prob_train_vec <- as.numeric(train_pred_prob)
}

# Ensure actual labels present in train_lr_df
if (!("repaid" %in% names(train_lr_df)) || all(is.na(train_lr_df$repaid))) {
  stop("train_lr_df does not contain 'repaid' labels or they are all NA. Cannot compute train metrics.")
}

actual_train <- factor(as.character(train_lr_df$repaid), levels = c("Not_Repaid", "Repaid"))
pred_train  <- factor(as.character(train_pred_class), levels = c("Not_Repaid", "Repaid"))

# Confusion matrix and basic metrics
cm_train <- caret::confusionMatrix(pred_train, actual_train, positive = "Repaid")

cat("\n=== TRAIN set performance ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Accuracy:  %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm_train$overall["Accuracy"])))
cat(sprintf("Sensitivity: %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm_train$byClass["Sensitivity"])))
cat(sprintf("Specificity: %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm_train$byClass["Specificity"])))
cat(sprintf("Precision: %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm_train$byClass["Precision"])))
cat(sprintf("F1: %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm_train$byClass["F1"])))

# ROC / AUC on train
auc_train <- NA_real_
if (!all(is.na(prob_train_vec)) && length(prob_train_vec) == length(actual_train)) {
  roc_train_obj <- tryCatch(pROC::roc(response = as.numeric(actual_train == "Repaid"),
                                     predictor = prob_train_vec, quiet = TRUE),
                            error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(roc_train_obj)) {
    auc_train <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_train_obj))
    cat(sprintf("ROC-AUC: %.6f\n", auc_train))
    # save ROC plot
    png(file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_roc_train.png"), width = 800, height = 600)
    plot(roc_train_obj, main = sprintf("Logistic Regression ROC (Train AUC=%.4f)", auc_train))
    dev.off()
    cat("Saved train ROC plot to:", file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_roc_train.png"), "\n")
  } else {
    cat("ROC on train could not be computed (error building roc object).\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Probability vector for train not available or length mismatch; ROC not computed for train.\n")
}

cat("\nConfusion matrix (train):\n")
print(cm_train$table)

# Save train predictions (with original predictors if available)
# Attempt to reconstruct train original predictors: if train_data exists, prefer it; else save from train_lr_df
train_out <- NULL
if (exists("train_data")) {
  # try to keep predictors + repaid
  keep_cols <- intersect(names(train_data), c(names(train_data), "repaid"))
  train_out <- train_data
  # append preds
  train_out$pred_class <- as.character(train_pred_class)
  train_out$prob_Repaid <- if (is.data.frame(train_pred_prob) && "Repaid" %in% colnames(train_pred_prob)) as.numeric(train_pred_prob[,"Repaid"]) else NA_real_
} else {
  # fallback: use train_lr_df (which contains design matrix + repaid)
  train_out <- train_lr_df
  train_out$pred_class <- as.character(train_pred_class)
  train_out$prob_Repaid <- if (is.data.frame(train_pred_prob) && "Repaid" %in% colnames(train_pred_prob)) as.numeric(train_pred_prob[,"Repaid"]) else NA_real_
}

# Save CSV
train_preds_file <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "train_data_with_preds.csv")
write.csv(train_out, train_preds_file, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved train predictions to:", train_preds_file, "\n")

# Save numeric metrics to CSV
metrics_train_df <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Accuracy","Sensitivity","Specificity","Precision","F1","ROC_AUC"),
  Value = c(
    as.numeric(cm_train$overall["Accuracy"]),
    as.numeric(cm_train$byClass["Sensitivity"]),
    as.numeric(cm_train$byClass["Specificity"]),
    as.numeric(cm_train$byClass["Precision"]),
    as.numeric(cm_train$byClass["F1"]),
    ifelse(is.na(auc_train), NA_real_, auc_train)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.csv(metrics_train_df, file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_train_metrics_printed.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved train metrics to:", file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_train_metrics_printed.csv"), "\n")

# Show first 10 rows of train predictions
cat("\n=== Train predictions (first 10 rows) ===\n")
print(utils::head(train_out[, c(intersect(names(train_out), c("repaid","pred_class","prob_Repaid")), setdiff(names(train_out), c("repaid","pred_class","prob_Repaid")) )], 10))

cat("\n=== Finished printing train results ===\n")

lr_out <- data.frame(
  actual = as.character(test_lr_df$repaid),
  pred = as.character(lr_pred_class),
  prob_Repaid = as.numeric(lr_pred_prob[,"Repaid"])
)
write.csv(lr_out, "model_outputs/lr_test_predictions.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

5.2 Random Forest
```{r}
# full_model_pipeline_all3_cv10.R
# Complete pipeline: LR (glm), RF, XGBoost
# - Uses fixed 7 features (original)
# - Stratified 70/30 split (train/test)
# - CV: repeatedcv with 10 folds x 3 repeats
# - Saves train/test preds, varimp, ROC plots and a combined metrics CSV

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(caret)
  library(dplyr)
  library(pROC)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(xgboost)
  library(randomForest)
  library(tibble)
})

set.seed(42)

# ------------------ Config ------------------
OUT_DIR <- file.path(getwd(), "model_outputs")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# fixed original 7 features (edit here if needed)
FEATURES_7 <- c(
  "car_value",
  "salary_range",
  "debt_to_income_ratio",
  "loan_length",
  "repaid_loan_on_prev_car",
  "driver_tenure",
  "size_of_downpayment"
)

TARGET <- "repaid"
TRAIN_PROP <- 0.70  # 70/30 split
CV_METHOD <- "repeatedcv"
CV_FOLDS  <- 10
CV_REPEATS <- 3

# ------------------ Helpers ------------------
find_source <- function() {
  candidates <- c("data", "data_transformed", "data_work", "data_clean", "data_raw")
  for (nm in candidates) {
    if (exists(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
      obj <- get(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      if (is.data.frame(obj)) return(list(name = nm, df = obj))
    }
  }
  return(NULL)
}

coerce_binary <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) return(as.integer(x))
  sx <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  res <- ifelse(sx %in% c("1","true","t","yes","y"), 1,
         ifelse(sx %in% c("0","false","f","no","n"), 0, NA))
  if (all(is.na(res))) {
    res2 <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.numeric(x)))
    if (!all(is.na(res2))) return(res2)
  }
  res
}

# safe extraction of positive-class probability
extract_prob_vector <- function(prob_obj) {
  if (is.null(prob_obj)) return(NULL)
  if (is.numeric(prob_obj) && is.vector(prob_obj)) return(as.numeric(prob_obj))
  if (is.matrix(prob_obj)) prob_obj <- as.data.frame(prob_obj)
  if (is.data.frame(prob_obj)) {
    if ("Repaid" %in% colnames(prob_obj)) return(as.numeric(prob_obj[,"Repaid"]))
    numeric_cols <- colnames(prob_obj)[sapply(prob_obj, is.numeric)]
    if (length(numeric_cols) >= 2) return(as.numeric(prob_obj[[ numeric_cols[2] ]]))
    if (length(numeric_cols) == 1) return(as.numeric(prob_obj[[ numeric_cols[1] ]]))
  }
  NULL
}

calc_and_print_metrics <- function(actual, pred_class = NULL, prob_vec = NULL, label = "SET", out_dir = OUT_DIR) {
  actual_f <- factor(tolower(as.character(actual)))
  actual_norm <- ifelse(actual_f %in% c("1","true","yes","y","repaid","paid"), "Repaid",
                        ifelse(actual_f %in% c("0","false","no","n","not_repaid","notrepaid","not repaid"), "Not_Repaid", NA))
  actual_f2 <- factor(actual_norm, levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))

  if (!is.null(pred_class)) {
    pred_norm <- factor(tolower(as.character(pred_class)))
    pred_norm2 <- ifelse(pred_norm %in% c("1","true","yes","y","repaid","paid"), "Repaid",
                         ifelse(pred_norm %in% c("0","false","no","n","not_repaid","notrepaid"), "Not_Repaid", NA))
    pred_f <- factor(pred_norm2, levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
  } else {
    pred_f <- NULL
  }

  if (!is.null(pred_f) && length(pred_f) != length(actual_f2)) pred_f <- NULL
  if (!is.null(prob_vec) && length(prob_vec) != length(actual_f2)) prob_vec <- NULL

  cm <- if (!is.null(pred_f)) tryCatch(confusionMatrix(pred_f, actual_f2, positive = "Repaid"), error = function(e) NULL) else NULL
  roc_obj <- if (!is.null(prob_vec)) tryCatch(roc(response = as.numeric(actual_f2 == "Repaid"), predictor = as.numeric(prob_vec), quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL) else NULL
  auc_v <- if (!is.null(roc_obj)) as.numeric(auc(roc_obj)) else NA_real_

  cat(sprintf("\n=== %s performance ===\n", label))
  if (!is.null(cm)) {
    cat(sprintf("Accuracy:  %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm$overall["Accuracy"])))
    cat(sprintf("Sensitivity: %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"])))
    cat(sprintf("Specificity: %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm$byClass["Specificity"])))
    cat(sprintf("Precision: %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm$byClass["Precision"])))
    cat(sprintf("F1: %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm$byClass["F1"])))
    cat(sprintf("Kappa: %.6f\n", as.numeric(cm$overall["Kappa"])))
  } else {
    cat("Confusion-matrix-based metrics: NA (predictions missing or mismatch length)\n")
  }
  if (!is.na(auc_v)) {
    cat(sprintf("ROC-AUC: %.6f\n", auc_v))
    png(file.path(out_dir, paste0(tolower(label), "_roc.png")), width = 800, height = 600)
    plot(roc_obj, main = sprintf("%s ROC (AUC=%.4f)", label, auc_v))
    dev.off()
    cat("Saved ROC plot:", file.path(out_dir, paste0(tolower(label), "_roc.png")), "\n")
  } else {
    cat("ROC-AUC: NA (probabilities missing or mismatch length)\n")
  }

  metrics <- tibble(
    Set = label,
    Accuracy = if(!is.null(cm)) as.numeric(cm$overall["Accuracy"]) else NA_real_,
    Sensitivity = if(!is.null(cm)) as.numeric(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"]) else NA_real_,
    Specificity = if(!is.null(cm)) as.numeric(cm$byClass["Specificity"]) else NA_real_,
    Precision = if(!is.null(cm)) as.numeric(cm$byClass["Precision"]) else NA_real_,
    F1 = if(!is.null(cm)) as.numeric(cm$byClass["F1"]) else NA_real_,
    AUC = auc_v,
    Kappa = if(!is.null(cm)) as.numeric(cm$overall["Kappa"]) else NA_real_
  )
  list(metrics = metrics, confusion = if(!is.null(cm)) cm$table else NULL, roc = roc_obj)
}

# ------------------ Find source dataset ------------------
src_info <- find_source()
if (is.null(src_info)) stop("No data object found. Please load your dataset into object 'data' or 'data_transformed' etc.")
src_df <- src_info$df
message("Using source object: ", src_info$name)

# ensure target exists
if (!(TARGET %in% names(src_df))) stop("Source dataset must contain target column: ", TARGET, " (please ensure your data object has a column named exactly 'repaid')")

# ------------------ Prepare features and data ------------------
features <- FEATURES_7[FEATURES_7 %in% names(src_df)]
if (length(features) < length(FEATURES_7)) {
  warning("Some FEATURES_7 are missing in source and will be ignored: ",
          paste(setdiff(FEATURES_7, features), collapse = ", "))
}
if (length(features) == 0) stop("None of the configured features found in source dataset.")

message("Using features: ", paste(features, collapse = ", "))

df <- src_df[, c(features, TARGET), drop = FALSE]

# Basic safe conversions
if ("salary_range" %in% colnames(df)) df$salary_range <- as.factor(df$salary_range)
if ("repaid_loan_on_prev_car" %in% colnames(df)) df$repaid_loan_on_prev_car <- coerce_binary(df$repaid_loan_on_prev_car)
if ("size_of_downpayment" %in% colnames(df)) {
  df$size_of_downpayment <- as.character(df$size_of_downpayment)
  df$size_of_downpayment <- gsub("%","", df$size_of_downpayment)
  df$size_of_downpayment <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df$size_of_downpayment)/100)
}
if ("driver_tenure" %in% colnames(df)) df$driver_tenure <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df$driver_tenure))

# target normalize to factor "Not_Repaid"/"Repaid"
if (is.numeric(df[[TARGET]]) || is.integer(df[[TARGET]])) {
  df[[TARGET]] <- factor(ifelse(df[[TARGET]] == 1, "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"), levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
} else {
  tmp <- tolower(trimws(as.character(df[[TARGET]])))
  df[[TARGET]] <- factor(ifelse(tmp %in% c("1","repaid","yes","y","true","paid"), "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"),
                         levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
}

# drop rows with NA in any predictor or target (conservative)
n_before <- nrow(df)
df <- df[complete.cases(df), , drop = FALSE]
n_after <- nrow(df)
message("Rows before filtering NA: ", n_before, ", after complete.cases on features+target: ", n_after)
if (n_after < 50) warning("Less than 50 rows remain after dropping NA. Model results may be unstable.")

# ------------------ Train/test split (stratified) ------------------
set.seed(42)
idx <- createDataPartition(df[[TARGET]], p = TRAIN_PROP, list = FALSE)
train_data <- df[idx, , drop = FALSE]
test_data  <- df[-idx, , drop = FALSE]
message("Train rows: ", nrow(train_data), "  Test rows: ", nrow(test_data))

# ------------------ Common trainControl ------------------
train_control <- trainControl(
  method = CV_METHOD,
  number = CV_FOLDS,
  repeats = ifelse(CV_METHOD == "repeatedcv", CV_REPEATS, NA),
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
  savePredictions = "final",
  verboseIter = FALSE
)

# ------------------ 1) Logistic Regression (caret glm) ------------------
message("\n--- Training Logistic Regression (glm) with CV: folds=", CV_FOLDS, ", repeats=", CV_REPEATS, " ---")
dv <- dummyVars(~ ., data = train_data[, features, drop = FALSE], fullRank = TRUE)
train_x_mat <- predict(dv, newdata = train_data[, features, drop = FALSE])
test_x_mat  <- predict(dv, newdata = test_data[, features, drop = FALSE])
train_lr_df <- as.data.frame(train_x_mat, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
train_lr_df$repaid <- train_data[[TARGET]]
test_lr_df <- as.data.frame(test_x_mat, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
test_lr_df$repaid <- test_data[[TARGET]]

nzv <- nearZeroVar(train_lr_df %>% select(-repaid), saveMetrics = TRUE)
if (any(nzv$nzv)) {
  drop_cols <- rownames(nzv)[nzv$nzv]
  message("LR: dropping NZV cols: ", paste(drop_cols, collapse = ", "))
  train_lr_df <- train_lr_df %>% select(-all_of(drop_cols))
  test_lr_df <- test_lr_df %>% select(-all_of(drop_cols))
}

set.seed(42)
lr_fit <- train(repaid ~ ., data = train_lr_df,
                method = "glm", family = "binomial",
                trControl = train_control, metric = "ROC",
                preProcess = c("center","scale"))

lr_train_prob <- predict(lr_fit, newdata = train_lr_df, type = "prob")
lr_train_pred <- predict(lr_fit, newdata = train_lr_df, type = "raw")
lr_test_prob <- predict(lr_fit, newdata = test_lr_df, type = "prob")
lr_test_pred <- predict(lr_fit, newdata = test_lr_df, type = "raw")

lr_out_test <- data.frame(actual = as.character(test_lr_df$repaid),
                          pred = as.character(lr_test_pred),
                          prob_Repaid = extract_prob_vector(lr_test_prob),
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
write.csv(lr_out_test, file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_test_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
lr_out_train <- data.frame(actual = as.character(train_lr_df$repaid),
                           pred = as.character(lr_train_pred),
                           prob_Repaid = extract_prob_vector(lr_train_prob),
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
write.csv(lr_out_train, file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_train_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

vi_lr <- tryCatch(varImp(lr_fit, scale = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(vi_lr)) {
  vi_lr_df <- as.data.frame(vi_lr$importance)
  vi_lr_df$Feature <- rownames(vi_lr_df)
  imp_col <- intersect(c("Overall"), colnames(vi_lr_df))
  if (length(imp_col)==0) imp_col <- colnames(vi_lr_df)[sapply(vi_lr_df, is.numeric)][1]
  vi_lr_df <- vi_lr_df %>% mutate(Overall = as.numeric(.data[[imp_col]])) %>% select(Overall, Feature) %>% arrange(desc(Overall))
  write.csv(vi_lr_df, file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_varimp.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}

lr_train_res <- calc_and_print_metrics(lr_out_train$actual, lr_out_train$pred, lr_out_train$prob_Repaid, label = "LR_TRAIN", out_dir = OUT_DIR)
lr_test_res  <- calc_and_print_metrics(lr_out_test$actual,  lr_out_test$pred,  lr_out_test$prob_Repaid,  label = "LR_TEST",  out_dir = OUT_DIR)

# ------------------ 2) Random Forest (caret rf) ------------------
message("\n--- Training Random Forest (rf) with CV: folds=", CV_FOLDS, ", repeats=", CV_REPEATS, " ---")
train_rf_df <- train_data[, c(features, TARGET), drop = FALSE]
test_rf_df  <- test_data[,  c(features, TARGET), drop = FALSE]

if ("repaid_loan_on_prev_car" %in% names(train_rf_df)) train_rf_df$repaid_loan_on_prev_car <- as.numeric(train_rf_df$repaid_loan_on_prev_car)
if ("repaid_loan_on_prev_car" %in% names(test_rf_df))  test_rf_df$repaid_loan_on_prev_car  <- as.numeric(test_rf_df$repaid_loan_on_prev_car)

preds_rf <- setdiff(names(train_rf_df), TARGET)
single_level <- sapply(preds_rf, function(p) length(unique(na.omit(train_rf_df[[p]]))) <= 1)
if (any(single_level)) {
  drop_p <- names(single_level)[single_level]
  message("RF: dropping single-level predictors: ", paste(drop_p, collapse = ", "))
  preds_rf <- setdiff(preds_rf, drop_p)
  train_rf_df <- train_rf_df[, c(preds_rf, TARGET), drop = FALSE]
  test_rf_df  <- test_rf_df[, c(intersect(c(preds_rf, TARGET), names(test_rf_df))), drop = FALSE]
}
if (length(preds_rf) == 0) stop("RF: no predictors left after pruning.")

mtry_try <- unique(pmin(length(preds_rf), c(2,3)))
tuneGrid_rf <- expand.grid(mtry = mtry_try)

set.seed(42)
rf_fit <- train(
  reformulate(preds_rf, response = TARGET),
  data = train_rf_df,
  method = "rf",
  metric = "ROC",
  trControl = train_control,
  tuneGrid = tuneGrid_rf,
  ntree = 200,
  importance = TRUE
)

rf_train_prob <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = train_rf_df, type = "prob")
rf_train_pred <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = train_rf_df, type = "raw")
rf_test_prob  <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = test_rf_df, type = "prob")
rf_test_pred  <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = test_rf_df, type = "raw")

rf_out_test <- data.frame(actual = as.character(test_rf_df[[TARGET]]),
                          pred = as.character(rf_test_pred),
                          prob_Repaid = extract_prob_vector(rf_test_prob),
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
write.csv(rf_out_test, file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_test_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
rf_out_train <- data.frame(actual = as.character(train_rf_df[[TARGET]]),
                           pred = as.character(rf_train_pred),
                           prob_Repaid = extract_prob_vector(rf_train_prob),
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
write.csv(rf_out_train, file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_train_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

vi_rf <- tryCatch(varImp(rf_fit, scale = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(vi_rf)) {
  vi_rf_df <- as.data.frame(vi_rf$importance)
  vi_rf_df$Feature <- rownames(vi_rf_df)
  imp_col <- if ("Overall" %in% colnames(vi_rf_df)) "Overall" else colnames(vi_rf_df)[sapply(vi_rf_df, is.numeric)][1]
  vi_rf_df <- vi_rf_df %>% mutate(Overall = as.numeric(.data[[imp_col]])) %>% select(Overall, Feature) %>% arrange(desc(Overall))
  write.csv(vi_rf_df, file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_varimp.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}

rf_train_res <- calc_and_print_metrics(rf_out_train$actual, rf_out_train$pred, rf_out_train$prob_Repaid, label = "RF_TRAIN", out_dir = OUT_DIR)
rf_test_res  <- calc_and_print_metrics(rf_out_test$actual,  rf_out_test$pred,  rf_out_test$prob_Repaid,  label = "RF_TEST",  out_dir = OUT_DIR)

# ------------------ 3) XGBoost (caret xgbTree) ------------------
message("\n--- Training XGBoost (xgbTree) with CV: folds=", CV_FOLDS, ", repeats=", CV_REPEATS, " ---")
train_xgb_df <- train_data[, c(features, TARGET), drop = FALSE]
test_xgb_df  <- test_data[,  c(features, TARGET), drop = FALSE]

for (cname in names(train_xgb_df)) {
  if (cname == TARGET) next
  if (is.ordered(train_xgb_df[[cname]])) train_xgb_df[[cname]] <- as.numeric(train_xgb_df[[cname]])
}
for (cname in names(test_xgb_df)) {
  if (cname == TARGET) next
  if (is.ordered(test_xgb_df[[cname]])) test_xgb_df[[cname]] <- as.numeric(test_xgb_df[[cname]])
}

tune_grid_xgb <- expand.grid(
  nrounds = c(100, 200),
  max_depth = c(3, 6),
  eta = c(0.01, 0.1),
  gamma = 0,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  min_child_weight = 1,
  subsample = 0.8
)

set.seed(42)
xgb_fit <- train(
  reformulate(setdiff(names(train_xgb_df), TARGET), TARGET),
  data = train_xgb_df,
  method = "xgbTree",
  trControl = train_control,
  tuneGrid = tune_grid_xgb,
  metric = "ROC",
  verbosity = 0
)

xgb_train_prob <- predict(xgb_fit, newdata = train_xgb_df, type = "prob")
xgb_train_pred <- predict(xgb_fit, newdata = train_xgb_df, type = "raw")
xgb_test_prob  <- predict(xgb_fit, newdata = test_xgb_df, type = "prob")
xgb_test_pred  <- predict(xgb_fit, newdata = test_xgb_df, type = "raw")

xgb_out_test <- data.frame(actual = as.character(test_xgb_df[[TARGET]]),
                           pred = as.character(xgb_test_pred),
                           prob_Repaid = extract_prob_vector(xgb_test_prob),
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
write.csv(xgb_out_test, file.path(OUT_DIR, "xgb_test_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
xgb_out_train <- data.frame(actual = as.character(train_xgb_df[[TARGET]]),
                            pred = as.character(xgb_train_pred),
                            prob_Repaid = extract_prob_vector(xgb_train_prob),
                            stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
write.csv(xgb_out_train, file.path(OUT_DIR, "xgb_train_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

vi_xgb <- tryCatch(varImp(xgb_fit, scale = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(vi_xgb)) {
  vi_xgb_df <- as.data.frame(vi_xgb$importance)
  vi_xgb_df$Feature <- rownames(vi_xgb_df)
  imp_col <- if ("Overall" %in% colnames(vi_xgb_df)) "Overall" else colnames(vi_xgb_df)[sapply(vi_xgb_df, is.numeric)][1]
  vi_xgb_df <- vi_xgb_df %>% mutate(Overall = as.numeric(.data[[imp_col]])) %>% select(Overall, Feature) %>% arrange(desc(Overall))
  write.csv(vi_xgb_df, file.path(OUT_DIR, "xgb_varimp.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}

xgb_train_res <- calc_and_print_metrics(xgb_out_train$actual, xgb_out_train$pred, xgb_out_train$prob_Repaid, label = "XGB_TRAIN", out_dir = OUT_DIR)
xgb_test_res  <- calc_and_print_metrics(xgb_out_test$actual,  xgb_out_test$pred,  xgb_out_test$prob_Repaid,  label = "XGB_TEST",  out_dir = OUT_DIR)

# ------------------ Combine metrics and save ------------------
metrics_all <- bind_rows(
  lr_train_res$metrics %>% mutate(Model = "LR"),
  lr_test_res$metrics  %>% mutate(Model = "LR"),
  rf_train_res$metrics %>% mutate(Model = "RF"),
  rf_test_res$metrics  %>% mutate(Model = "RF"),
  xgb_train_res$metrics %>% mutate(Model = "XGB"),
  xgb_test_res$metrics  %>% mutate(Model = "XGB")
) %>% select(Model, Set, everything())

write.csv(metrics_all, file.path(OUT_DIR, "all_models_metrics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
message("Saved combined metrics to: ", file.path(OUT_DIR, "all_models_metrics.csv"))

message("\nPipeline complete. Outputs (preds, varimp, metrics, ROC) in: ", normalizePath(OUT_DIR))

```

5.3 XGBoost
```{r}
# XGBoost End-to-End (robust) — fixed to original 7 features, CV = 10, save TRAIN+TEST outputs
rm(list = ls())
set.seed(42)

# -------------------------
# Settings
# -------------------------
data_path <- "car_loan_data_with_tenure.csv"  # <- change if needed
out_prefix <- "phase_xgb"
getwd()

# -------------------------
# Packages
# -------------------------
req <- c("tidyverse","caret","xgboost","pROC","data.table","MLmetrics")
for(pk in req){
  if(!requireNamespace(pk, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(pk, dependencies = TRUE)
  library(pk, character.only = TRUE)
}

# -------------------------
# Load data (prefer in-memory 'data' if exists)
# -------------------------
if(exists("data") && is.data.frame(data)){
  cat("Using data already in memory (object 'data').\n")
} else {
  if(!file.exists(data_path)) stop("Data file not found: ", data_path)
  data <- read.csv(data_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  cat("Loaded data from file:", data_path, " (", nrow(data), "rows )\n")
}

names(data) <- trimws(names(data))

# -------------------------
# Original 7 features (fixed)
# -------------------------
features <- c(
  "car_value",
  "salary_range",
  "debt_to_income_ratio",
  "loan_length",
  "repaid_loan_on_prev_car",
  "driver_tenure",
  "size_of_downpayment"
)

# check features exist (if a feature missing, script will continue but warn and drop rows accordingly)
present_feats <- features[features %in% names(data)]
missing_feats <- setdiff(features, present_feats)
if(length(missing_feats) > 0) {
  warning("The following of the 7 features are missing from the data and will be absent: ", paste(missing_feats, collapse = ", "))
}
use_features <- intersect(features, names(data))
cat("Using features (present):", paste(use_features, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# -------------------------
# Preprocessing specific to these features
# -------------------------
# size_of_downpayment: "30%" -> 0.3
if("size_of_downpayment" %in% names(data)){
  data$size_of_downpayment <- as.character(data$size_of_downpayment)
  data$size_of_downpayment <- gsub("%", "", data$size_of_downpayment)
  data$size_of_downpayment <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(data$size_of_downpayment) / 100)
  # if conversion failed, NA will appear
}

# repaid_loan_on_prev_car -> 0/1 robustly
if("repaid_loan_on_prev_car" %in% names(data)){
  col <- data$repaid_loan_on_prev_car
  if(is.logical(col)) data$repaid_loan_on_prev_car <- as.integer(col)
  else if(is.character(col)){
    tmp <- tolower(trimws(col))
    data$repaid_loan_on_prev_car <- ifelse(tmp %in% c("true","t","yes","y","1"), 1,
                                     ifelse(tmp %in% c("false","f","no","n","0"), 0, NA))
  } else {
    data$repaid_loan_on_prev_car <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.numeric(col)))
  }
}

# numeric coercion for obvious numeric cols
numeric_cols_try <- c("car_value","debt_to_income_ratio","loan_length","driver_tenure")
for(nc in intersect(numeric_cols_try, names(data))){
  data[[nc]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(data[[nc]]))
}

# salary_range -> keep as factor (trees can use factor)
if("salary_range" %in% names(data) && !is.factor(data$salary_range)) {
  data$salary_range <- as.factor(data$salary_range)
}

# -------------------------
# Target normalization -> factor levels c("Not_Repaid","Repaid")
# -------------------------
if(!"repaid" %in% names(data)) stop("Target column 'repaid' not found.")
if(is.numeric(data$repaid) || is.integer(data$repaid)){
  data$repaid <- factor(ifelse(data$repaid == 1, "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"),
                        levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
} else {
  tmp <- tolower(trimws(as.character(data$repaid)))
  if(all(c("0","1") %in% unique(tmp))){
    data$repaid <- factor(ifelse(tmp == "1", "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"), levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
  } else {
    # best-effort mapping common textual values
    data$repaid <- factor(ifelse(tmp %in% c("repaid","yes","y","true","1","paid"), "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"),
                          levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
  }
}

# -------------------------
# Build modeling df & drop NA (only on the used features + target)
# -------------------------
model_cols <- c(use_features, "repaid")
df <- data[, intersect(model_cols, names(data)), drop = FALSE]
n_before <- nrow(data)
n_after_drop <- nrow(na.omit(df))
df <- df[complete.cases(df), ]
cat("Rows before:", n_before, "after dropping rows with NA in modelling cols:", n_after_drop, "\n")
if(nrow(df) < 30) stop("Too few rows after drop NA to train reliably.")

# convert ordered factors to numeric if any (just in case)
for(col in setdiff(names(df), "repaid")){
  if(is.ordered(df[[col]])) df[[col]] <- as.numeric(df[[col]])
}

# -------------------------
# Train/test split 70/30 (stratified)
# -------------------------
set.seed(42)
idx <- createDataPartition(df$repaid, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
train_data <- df[idx, , drop = FALSE]
test_data  <- df[-idx, , drop = FALSE]
cat("Train:", nrow(train_data), "Test:", nrow(test_data), "\n")

# -------------------------
# Train control + tune grid (CV folds = 10)
# -------------------------
train_control_xgb <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 10,   # 10-fold CV
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
  savePredictions = "final",
  verboseIter = TRUE
)

tune_grid_xgb <- expand.grid(
  nrounds = c(100, 200),
  max_depth = c(3, 6),
  eta = c(0.01, 0.1),
  gamma = 0,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  min_child_weight = 1,
  subsample = 0.8
)

cat("Tuning grid rows:", nrow(tune_grid_xgb), "\n")
cat("Features used in model:", paste(setdiff(names(train_data), "repaid"), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# -------------------------
# Train model
# -------------------------
cat("Training XGBoost (caret::train with xgbTree) — CV folds = 10...\n")
t0 <- Sys.time()
xgb_model <- train(
  repaid ~ .,
  data = train_data,
  method = "xgbTree",
  trControl = train_control_xgb,
  tuneGrid = tune_grid_xgb,
  metric = "ROC",
  verbosity = 0
)
t1 <- Sys.time()
cat("Training time (sec):", round(as.numeric(difftime(t1, t0, units = "secs")), 1), "\n")

cat("\nBest tuning parameters:\n"); print(xgb_model$bestTune)
cat("\nTop CV results by ROC:\n"); print(head(xgb_model$results[order(-xgb_model$results$ROC), ], 6))

# -------------------------
# Predictions on TEST
# -------------------------
pred_prob_df <- predict(xgb_model, test_data, type = "prob")
pos_label <- if("Repaid" %in% levels(test_data$repaid)) "Repaid" else levels(test_data$repaid)[length(levels(test_data$repaid))]
if(pos_label %in% colnames(pred_prob_df)) prob_pos <- pred_prob_df[, pos_label] else prob_pos <- pred_prob_df[, ncol(pred_prob_df)]
pred_class <- predict(xgb_model, test_data, type = "raw")
pred_class <- factor(pred_class, levels = levels(test_data$repaid))

cm <- confusionMatrix(pred_class, test_data$repaid, positive = pos_label)
cat("\nConfusion matrix (TEST):\n"); print(cm$table)
cat("\nCaret overall (TEST):\n"); print(cm$overall)
cat("\nCaret byClass (TEST):\n"); print(cm$byClass)

# compute TP/TN/FP/FN robustly
tbl <- as.table(cm$table)
if (nrow(tbl) == 2 && ncol(tbl) == 2) {
  TP <- as.numeric(tbl[pos_label, pos_label])
  other <- setdiff(rownames(tbl), pos_label)
  TN <- as.numeric(tbl[other, other])
  FP <- as.numeric(tbl[pos_label, other])
  FN <- as.numeric(tbl[other, pos_label])
} else {
  TP <- sum(test_data$repaid == pos_label & pred_class == pos_label, na.rm = TRUE)
  FP <- sum(test_data$repaid != pos_label & pred_class == pos_label, na.rm = TRUE)
  FN <- sum(test_data$repaid == pos_label & pred_class != pos_label, na.rm = TRUE)
  TN <- sum(test_data$repaid != pos_label & pred_class != pos_label, na.rm = TRUE)
}
tot <- TP + TN + FP + FN

accuracy <- (TP + TN) / tot
sensitivity <- ifelse((TP + FN)>0, TP / (TP + FN), NA)
specificity <- ifelse((TN + FP)>0, TN / (TN + FP), NA)
precision <- ifelse((TP + FP)>0, TP / (TP + FP), NA)
f1 <- ifelse(!is.na(precision) & !is.na(sensitivity) & (precision + sensitivity)>0, 2 * precision * sensitivity / (precision + sensitivity), NA)
balanced_acc <- mean(c(sensitivity, specificity), na.rm = TRUE)
denom <- sqrt((TP + FP)*(TP + FN)*(TN + FP)*(TN + FN))
mcc <- ifelse(denom == 0, NA, (TP*TN - FP*FN)/denom)

# AUC, Gini, KS
roc_obj <- roc(response = test_data$repaid, predictor = prob_pos, levels = rev(levels(test_data$repaid)), direction = "<")
auc_val <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
gini <- 2*auc_val - 1
tpr <- roc_obj$sensitivities
fpr <- 1 - roc_obj$specificities
ks_val <- max(abs(tpr - fpr))

cat("\n=== XGBoost Performance Metrics (TEST) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Accuracy: %.4f\n", accuracy))
cat(sprintf("Sensitivity (Recall): %.4f\n", sensitivity))
cat(sprintf("Specificity: %.4f\n", specificity))
cat(sprintf("Precision: %.4f\n", precision))
cat(sprintf("F1-score: %.4f\n", f1))
cat(sprintf("Balanced Accuracy: %.4f\n", balanced_acc))
cat(sprintf("MCC: %.4f\n", mcc))
cat(sprintf("AUC: %.4f\n", auc_val))
cat(sprintf("Gini: %.4f\n", gini))
cat(sprintf("KS: %.4f\n", ks_val))

# save TEST ROC
png(paste0(out_prefix, "_roc_test.png"), width = 800, height = 600)
plot(roc_obj, main = sprintf("XGBoost TEST ROC (AUC=%.4f)", auc_val))
dev.off()

# -------------------------
# Predictions on TRAIN
# -------------------------
train_pred_prob_df <- predict(xgb_model, train_data, type = "prob")
if(pos_label %in% colnames(train_pred_prob_df)) train_prob_pos <- train_pred_prob_df[, pos_label] else train_prob_pos <- train_pred_prob_df[, ncol(train_pred_prob_df)]
train_pred_class <- predict(xgb_model, train_data, type = "raw")
train_pred_class <- factor(train_pred_class, levels = levels(train_data$repaid))

cm_train <- confusionMatrix(train_pred_class, train_data$repaid, positive = pos_label)
cat("\nConfusion matrix (TRAIN):\n"); print(cm_train$table)
cat("\nCaret overall (TRAIN):\n"); print(cm_train$overall)
cat("\nCaret byClass (TRAIN):\n"); print(cm_train$byClass)

# train metrics
tbl_tr <- as.table(cm_train$table)
if (nrow(tbl_tr) == 2 && ncol(tbl_tr) == 2) {
  TP_tr <- as.numeric(tbl_tr[pos_label, pos_label])
  other_tr <- setdiff(rownames(tbl_tr), pos_label)
  TN_tr <- as.numeric(tbl_tr[other_tr, other_tr])
  FP_tr <- as.numeric(tbl_tr[pos_label, other_tr])
  FN_tr <- as.numeric(tbl_tr[other_tr, pos_label])
} else {
  TP_tr <- sum(train_data$repaid == pos_label & train_pred_class == pos_label, na.rm = TRUE)
  FP_tr <- sum(train_data$repaid != pos_label & train_pred_class == pos_label, na.rm = TRUE)
  FN_tr <- sum(train_data$repaid == pos_label & train_pred_class != pos_label, na.rm = TRUE)
  TN_tr <- sum(train_data$repaid != pos_label & train_pred_class != pos_label, na.rm = TRUE)
}
tot_tr <- TP_tr + TN_tr + FP_tr + FN_tr

accuracy_tr <- (TP_tr + TN_tr) / tot_tr
sensitivity_tr <- ifelse((TP_tr + FN_tr)>0, TP_tr / (TP_tr + FN_tr), NA)
specificity_tr <- ifelse((TN_tr + FP_tr)>0, TN_tr / (TN_tr + FP_tr), NA)
precision_tr <- ifelse((TP_tr + FP_tr)>0, TP_tr / (TP_tr + FP_tr), NA)
f1_tr <- ifelse(!is.na(precision_tr) & !is.na(sensitivity_tr) & (precision_tr + sensitivity_tr)>0, 2 * precision_tr * sensitivity_tr / (precision_tr + sensitivity_tr), NA)
balanced_acc_tr <- mean(c(sensitivity_tr, specificity_tr), na.rm = TRUE)
denom_tr <- sqrt((TP_tr + FP_tr)*(TP_tr + FN_tr)*(TN_tr + FP_tr)*(TN_tr + FN_tr))
mcc_tr <- ifelse(denom_tr == 0, NA, (TP_tr*TN_tr - FP_tr*FN_tr)/denom_tr)

roc_train_obj <- roc(response = train_data$repaid, predictor = train_prob_pos, levels = rev(levels(train_data$repaid)), direction = "<")
auc_train <- as.numeric(auc(roc_train_obj))

png(paste0(out_prefix, "_roc_train.png"), width = 800, height = 600)
plot(roc_train_obj, main = sprintf("XGBoost TRAIN ROC (AUC=%.4f)", auc_train))
dev.off()

cat("\n=== XGBoost Performance Metrics (TRAIN) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Accuracy: %.4f\n", accuracy_tr))
cat(sprintf("Sensitivity (Recall): %.4f\n", sensitivity_tr))
cat(sprintf("Specificity: %.4f\n", specificity_tr))
cat(sprintf("Precision: %.4f\n", precision_tr))
cat(sprintf("F1-score: %.4f\n", f1_tr))
cat(sprintf("Balanced Accuracy: %.4f\n", balanced_acc_tr))
cat(sprintf("MCC: %.4f\n", mcc_tr))
cat(sprintf("AUC: %.4f\n", auc_train))

# -------------------------
# Variable importance
# -------------------------
cat("\nTop variable importance (caret::varImp):\n")
vi <- varImp(xgb_model, scale = TRUE)
print(vi)
vi_df <- as.data.frame(vi$importance)
vi_df$Feature <- rownames(vi_df)
if("Overall" %in% colnames(vi_df)) {
  vi_df <- vi_df[order(-vi_df$Overall), , drop = FALSE]
} else {
  numcols <- names(vi_df)[sapply(vi_df, is.numeric)]
  if(length(numcols) > 0) vi_df$Overall <- rowMeans(vi_df[, numcols, drop = FALSE])
  vi_df <- vi_df[order(-vi_df$Overall), , drop = FALSE]
}
print(head(vi_df, 20))

# -------------------------
# Save outputs
# -------------------------
summary_df <- data.frame(
  Model = "XGBoost",
  Feature_Set = "original_7",
  Accuracy_TEST = accuracy, Recall_TEST = sensitivity, Specificity_TEST = specificity,
  Precision_TEST = precision, F1_TEST = f1, Balanced_Accuracy_TEST = balanced_acc,
  MCC_TEST = mcc, AUC_TEST = auc_val, Gini_TEST = gini, KS_TEST = ks_val,
  TP_TEST = TP, FP_TEST = FP, TN_TEST = TN, FN_TEST = FN,
  Accuracy_TRAIN = accuracy_tr, Recall_TRAIN = sensitivity_tr, Specificity_TRAIN = specificity_tr,
  Precision_TRAIN = precision_tr, F1_TRAIN = f1_tr, Balanced_Accuracy_TRAIN = balanced_acc_tr,
  MCC_TRAIN = mcc_tr, AUC_TRAIN = auc_train,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

write.csv(summary_df, paste0(out_prefix, "_summary_original7.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(as.data.frame(cm$table), paste0(out_prefix, "_confusion_test_original7.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(as.data.frame(cm_train$table), paste0(out_prefix, "_confusion_train_original7.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(vi_df, paste0(out_prefix, "_varimp_original7.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Save predictions (test + train)
test_save <- test_data
test_save$pred_class <- as.character(pred_class)
test_save$prob_Repaid <- prob_pos
write.csv(test_save, paste0(out_prefix, "_test_preds_original7.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

train_save <- train_data
train_save$pred_class <- as.character(train_pred_class)
train_save$prob_Repaid <- train_prob_pos
write.csv(train_save, paste0(out_prefix, "_train_preds_original7.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nSaved summary/confusion/varimp/train_preds/test_preds CSVs with prefix:", out_prefix, "\n")
cat("\nXGBoost pipeline complete.\n")
```

6. Model Evaluation
6.1 Performance Metrics
```{r}
# compact_three_model_compare_fixed_v2.R
# Calculate Performance Metrics for All Models (robust + train/test support)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(caret)
  library(pROC)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
})

# -------- Config --------
save_dir <- "model_outputs"
dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Models/prefixes to consider (lowercase)
prefixes <- c("lr", "rf", "xgb")

# Optional: if you have additional suffixes for files, add them here for scanning
candidate_test_suffixes <- c("_test_predictions.csv","_test_preds.csv","_test_predictions_all.csv","_test_preds_all.csv","_test_preds_light.csv","_test_preds.csv")
candidate_train_suffixes <- c("_train_predictions.csv","_train_preds.csv","_train_preds_all.csv","_train_preds.csv")

# -------- Helpers --------
norm_lbl <- function(x) {
  # Normalize labels to factor(c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
  if (is.null(x)) return(factor(character(0), levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid")))
  xc <- tolower(as.character(x))
  xc[xc %in% c("1","true","yes","repaid","y","t","paid")] <- "Repaid"
  xc[xc %in% c("0","false","no","not_repaid","n","notrepaid","not repaid")] <- "Not_Repaid"
  res <- ifelse(xc == "Repaid","Repaid", ifelse(xc == "Not_Repaid","Not_Repaid", NA_character_))
  factor(res, levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
}

extract_positive_prob <- function(obj) {
  # Accept numeric vector, matrix, data.frame with Repaid column, or probability matrix
  if (is.null(obj)) return(NULL)
  # numeric vector
  if (is.numeric(obj) && is.vector(obj)) return(as.numeric(obj))
  # matrix or data.frame
  if (is.matrix(obj)) obj <- as.data.frame(obj)
  if (is.data.frame(obj)) {
    cn <- colnames(obj)
    if (!is.null(cn) && "Repaid" %in% cn) return(as.numeric(obj[,"Repaid"]))
    # if two numeric columns, assume second is positive class
    numeric_cols <- cn[sapply(obj, is.numeric)]
    if (length(numeric_cols) >= 2) return(as.numeric(obj[[ numeric_cols[2] ]]))
    if (length(numeric_cols) == 1) return(as.numeric(obj[[ numeric_cols[1] ]]))
    # fallback: try coercing first column to numeric
    tmp <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(obj[[1]]))
    if (!all(is.na(tmp))) return(tmp)
  }
  NULL
}

# robust reader / heuristics for actual/pred/prob columns
read_preds_from_csv <- function(f) {
  df <- tryCatch(read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)
  cn_low <- tolower(colnames(df))

  # heuristics for actual/label column
  actual_idx <- which(grepl("(^actual$|^y$|^label$|^truth$|^target$|^reference$|^ref$)", cn_low))
  if (length(actual_idx) == 0) {
    actual_idx <- which(grepl("repaid|target|truth|actual|label", cn_low))
  }
  actual_col <- if (length(actual_idx) > 0) colnames(df)[actual_idx[1]] else NA

  # heuristics for predicted class column
  pred_idx <- which(grepl("pred.*class|predicted|^pred$|^class$|prediction|pred_class", cn_low))
  pred_col <- if (length(pred_idx) > 0) colnames(df)[pred_idx[1]] else NA

  # heuristics for probability column
  prob_idx <- which(grepl("prob|probability|pred_prob|repaid_prob|prob_repaid|score", cn_low))
  prob_col <- if (length(prob_idx) > 0) colnames(df)[prob_idx[1]] else NA

  # fallback numeric columns for prob if not identified
  if (is.na(prob_col)) {
    nums <- colnames(df)[sapply(df, is.numeric)]
    # prefer second numeric column (common convention: first numeric might be id)
    if (length(nums) >= 2) prob_col <- nums[2] else if (length(nums) == 1) prob_col <- nums[1]
  }

  actual_v <- if (!is.na(actual_col) && actual_col %in% colnames(df)) df[[actual_col]] else NULL
  pred_v   <- if (!is.na(pred_col)   && pred_col   %in% colnames(df)) df[[pred_col]]   else NULL

  prob_v <- NULL
  if (!is.na(prob_col) && prob_col %in% colnames(df)) {
    candidate <- df[[prob_col]]
    # if column is not directly numeric (e.g., a JSON-like string), try coercion
    if (is.character(candidate) && all(grepl("^\\s*\\d+\\.?\\d*\\s*$", na.omit(candidate)))) {
      prob_v <- as.numeric(candidate)
    } else {
      prob_v <- extract_positive_prob(candidate)
      # if still NULL and there exist two numeric columns, try combining them into a 2-col df for extract_positive_prob
      if (is.null(prob_v)) {
        nums <- which(sapply(df, is.numeric))
        if (length(nums) >= 2) prob_v <- extract_positive_prob(df[, nums[1:2]])
      }
    }
  }

  list(actual = actual_v, pred = pred_v, prob = prob_v, path = f)
}

# search for csv with prefix heuristics
find_csv_for_prefix <- function(prefix, which_set = c("test","train"), dir = save_dir) {
  which_set <- match.arg(which_set)
  candidates <- if (which_set == "test") candidate_test_suffixes else candidate_train_suffixes
  for (suf in candidates) {
    f <- file.path(dir, paste0(prefix, suf))
    if (file.exists(f)) return(f)
    # also try prefix + "_" + suffix (in case prefix already has underscore)
    f2 <- file.path(dir, paste0(prefix, "_", suf))
    if (file.exists(f2)) return(f2)
  }
  # more flexible scan: list files containing prefix and containing test/train tokens
  files <- list.files(dir, pattern = paste0(prefix, ".*(test|train).*csv$"), full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  if (length(files) > 0) return(files[1])
  NULL
}

# Try to gather predictions for a prefix (tries csv, then environment objects, then model predict using test_data)
get_preds_for_prefix <- function(prefix, save_dir) {
  # 1) try test CSV
  test_csv <- find_csv_for_prefix(prefix, "test", save_dir)
  if (!is.null(test_csv)) {
    r <- read_preds_from_csv(test_csv)
    if (!is.null(r)) { r$from <- "csv_test"; return(r) }
  }

  # 2) try train CSV (if no test file found for this prefix, still record train file later)
  # but primarily we want test predictions; we'll handle train separately later

  # 3) try environment objects (common variable names)
  cls_names  <- c(paste0(prefix, "_pred_class"), paste0(prefix, "_pred"), paste0(prefix, "_predictions"), paste0(prefix, "_preds"))
  prob_names <- c(paste0(prefix, "_pred_prob"), paste0(prefix, "_pred_probs"), paste0(prefix, "_prob"), paste0(prefix, "_pred_probability"))
  cls_obj <- NULL; prob_obj <- NULL
  for (n in cls_names) if (exists(n, envir = .GlobalEnv)) { cls_obj <- get(n, envir = .GlobalEnv); break }
  for (n in prob_names) if (exists(n, envir = .GlobalEnv)) { prob_obj <- get(n, envir = .GlobalEnv); break }

  # 4) If not found and test_data exists in env, try to predict using model object names
  if ((is.null(cls_obj) || is.null(prob_obj)) && exists("test_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    td <- get("test_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)
    model_names <- c(paste0(prefix, "_model"), prefix, paste0(prefix, "model"), paste0(prefix, "_fit"))
    for (mn in model_names) {
      if (exists(mn, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
        m <- get(mn, envir = .GlobalEnv)
        # caret::train object
        if (inherits(m, "train")) {
          try({ if (is.null(cls_obj)) cls_obj <- predict(m, td, type = "raw") }, silent = TRUE)
          try({ if (is.null(prob_obj)) prob_obj <- tryCatch(predict(m, td, type = "prob"), error = function(e) NULL) }, silent = TRUE)
        }
        # xgboost booster
        if (inherits(m, "xgb.Booster") || inherits(m, "xgb.Booster.handle")) {
          try({
            tdf <- td
            if ("repaid" %in% colnames(tdf)) tdf <- tdf %>% select(-repaid)
            # create sparse/dense matrix model.matrix style
            X_test <- tryCatch(sparse.model.matrix(~ . -1, data = tdf), error = function(e) NULL)
            if (!is.null(X_test)) {
              prob_try <- tryCatch(predict(m, xgb.DMatrix(X_test)), error = function(e) NULL)
              if (!is.null(prob_try)) {
                prob_obj <- prob_try
                cls_obj <- ifelse(prob_try >= 0.5, "Repaid", "Not_Repaid")
              }
            }
          }, silent = TRUE)
        }
        # generic predict fallback
        try({
          if (is.null(cls_obj)) {
            pr <- tryCatch(predict(m, td, type = "raw"), error = function(e) NULL)
            if (!is.null(pr)) cls_obj <- pr
          }
          if (is.null(prob_obj)) {
            prb <- tryCatch(predict(m, td, type = "prob"), error = function(e) NULL)
            if (!is.null(prb)) prob_obj <- prb
          }
        }, silent = TRUE)
      }
      if (!is.null(cls_obj) || !is.null(prob_obj)) break
    }
  }

  actual_v <- if (exists("test_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)) get("test_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)$repaid else NULL
  prob_v <- extract_positive_prob(prob_obj)
  list(from = "memory", actual = actual_v, pred = cls_obj, prob = prob_v)
}

# Compute metrics robustly (returns tibble)
compute_metrics <- function(actual_raw, pred_raw = NULL, prob_raw = NULL, model_name = "model") {
  actual_f <- norm_lbl(actual_raw)
  if (length(actual_f) == 0) stop("Empty actuals for model: ", model_name)

  # derive pred if missing but prob exists
  if (is.null(pred_raw) && !is.null(prob_raw) && length(prob_raw) == length(actual_f)) {
    pred_f <- factor(ifelse(as.numeric(prob_raw) >= 0.5, "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"), levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
  } else if (!is.null(pred_raw)) {
    pred_f <- norm_lbl(pred_raw)
  } else {
    pred_f <- NULL
  }

  # align lengths
  if (!is.null(pred_f) && length(pred_f) != length(actual_f)) pred_f <- NULL
  if (!is.null(prob_raw) && length(prob_raw) != length(actual_f)) prob_raw <- NULL

  cm <- if (!is.null(pred_f)) tryCatch(confusionMatrix(pred_f, actual_f, positive = "Repaid"), error = function(e) NULL) else NULL
  roc_obj <- if (!is.null(prob_raw)) tryCatch(pROC::roc(response = as.numeric(actual_f == "Repaid"), predictor = as.numeric(prob_raw), quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL) else NULL
  auc_val <- if (!is.null(roc_obj)) as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_obj)) else NA_real_
  kappa_v <- if (!is.null(cm)) as.numeric(cm$overall["Kappa"]) else NA_real_

  tibble(Model = model_name,
         Accuracy = if (!is.null(cm)) as.numeric(cm$overall["Accuracy"]) else NA_real_,
         Sensitivity = if (!is.null(cm)) as.numeric(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"]) else NA_real_,
         Specificity = if (!is.null(cm)) as.numeric(cm$byClass["Specificity"]) else NA_real_,
         Precision = if (!is.null(cm)) as.numeric(cm$byClass["Precision"]) else NA_real_,
         F1_Score = if (!is.null(cm)) as.numeric(cm$byClass["F1"]) else NA_real_,
         AUC = auc_val,
         Kappa = kappa_v)
}

# -------- Main: evaluate prefixes for TEST and TRAIN (if available) --------
results_rows <- list()
roc_objs <- list()

for (pref in prefixes) {
  message("\n--- Processing prefix: ", pref, " ---")

  # TEST: try to read CSV or env/predict
  info_test <- get_preds_for_prefix(pref, save_dir)
  if (!is.null(info_test) && !is.null(info_test$actual) && length(info_test$actual) > 0) {
    try({
      tbl_test <- compute_metrics(info_test$actual, info_test$pred, info_test$prob, model_name = toupper(paste0(pref,"_TEST")))
      results_rows[[paste0(toupper(pref),"_TEST")]] <- tbl_test
      # collect roc object if probs available
      if (!is.null(info_test$prob) && length(info_test$prob) == length(info_test$actual)) {
        actual_f <- norm_lbl(info_test$actual)
        roc_o <- tryCatch(pROC::roc(response = as.numeric(actual_f == "Repaid"), predictor = as.numeric(info_test$prob), quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
        if (!is.null(roc_o)) roc_objs[[toupper(paste0(pref,"_TEST"))]] <- roc_o
      }
      message("  -> collected TEST metrics for ", pref)
    }, silent = FALSE)
  } else {
    message("  No test predictions/actuals found for prefix: ", pref, " (skip TEST).")
  }

  # TRAIN: attempt to find train csv (prefix_train_... or env objects)
  train_csv <- find_csv_for_prefix(pref, "train", save_dir)
  info_train <- NULL
  if (!is.null(train_csv)) {
    info_train <- read_preds_from_csv(train_csv)
    info_train$from <- "csv_train"
  } else {
    # try env objects named like prefix_train_pred_class / prefix_train_pred_prob
    cls_name <- paste0(pref, "_train_pred_class")
    prob_name <- paste0(pref, "_train_pred_prob")
    cls_obj <- if (exists(cls_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) get(cls_name, envir = .GlobalEnv) else NULL
    prob_obj <- if (exists(prob_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) get(prob_name, envir = .GlobalEnv) else NULL
    if (!is.null(cls_obj) || !is.null(prob_obj)) {
      if (exists("train_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
        actual_train <- get("train_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)$repaid
      } else {
        actual_train <- NULL
      }
      info_train <- list(from = "env_train", actual = actual_train, pred = cls_obj, prob = extract_positive_prob(prob_obj))
    }
  }

  if (!is.null(info_train) && !is.null(info_train$actual) && length(info_train$actual) > 0) {
    try({
      tbl_train <- compute_metrics(info_train$actual, info_train$pred, info_train$prob, model_name = toupper(paste0(pref,"_TRAIN")))
      results_rows[[paste0(toupper(pref),"_TRAIN")]] <- tbl_train
      # collect roc for train if available
      if (!is.null(info_train$prob) && length(info_train$prob) == length(info_train$actual)) {
        actual_f_tr <- norm_lbl(info_train$actual)
        roc_o_tr <- tryCatch(pROC::roc(response = as.numeric(actual_f_tr == "Repaid"), predictor = as.numeric(info_train$prob), quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
        if (!is.null(roc_o_tr)) roc_objs[[toupper(paste0(pref,"_TRAIN"))]] <- roc_o_tr
      }
      message("  -> collected TRAIN metrics for ", pref)
    }, silent = FALSE)
  } else {
    message("  No train predictions/actuals found for prefix: ", pref, " (skip TRAIN).")
  }
}

if (length(results_rows) == 0) stop("No model results collected. Ensure predictions CSVs exist in '", save_dir, "' or models/test_data present in environment.")

# combine into table and order by AUC (desc)
metrics_tbl <- bind_rows(results_rows) %>% arrange(desc(AUC))
print(metrics_tbl)

# save csv
out_metrics_file <- file.path(save_dir, "models_comparison_metrics.csv")
write.csv(metrics_tbl, out_metrics_file, row.names = FALSE)
message("Saved metrics CSV -> ", out_metrics_file)

# combined ROC plot for any *_TEST entries we have probabilities for
roc_entries <- names(roc_objs)[grepl("_TEST$", names(roc_objs))]
if (length(roc_entries) > 0) {
  roc_df <- bind_rows(lapply(roc_entries, function(nm) {
    r <- roc_objs[[nm]]
    data.frame(model = nm, fpr = 1 - r$specificities, tpr = r$sensitivities, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  p <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(x = fpr, y = tpr, color = model)) +
    geom_line(size = 1) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    labs(x = "False Positive Rate", y = "True Positive Rate", title = "ROC Curves - Model Comparison (TEST)") +
    theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  print(p)
  roc_file <- file.path(save_dir, "models_combined_roc_test.png")
  ggsave(roc_file, plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 150)
  message("Saved ROC plot -> ", roc_file)
} else {
  message("No TEST ROC curves found (no probability vectors).")
}

message("\nDone. Outputs in: ", normalizePath(save_dir))
```
