6.3 ROC Curves Comparison

```{r}
# full_pipeline_with_immediate_roc.R
# Complete pipeline: LR (glm), RF, XGBoost
# Fixed 7 features, stratified 70/30 split, repeatedcv (10 folds x 3 repeats)
# Saves outputs and also plots ROC curves directly to R Plot panel

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  pkgs <- c("caret","dplyr","pROC","ggplot2","xgboost","randomForest","tibble")
  for (p in pkgs) {
    if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) {
      install.packages(p, dependencies = TRUE)
    }
    library(p, character.only = TRUE)
  }
})

set.seed(42)

# ---------------- Config ----------------
OUT_DIR <- file.path(getwd(), "model_outputs")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

FEATURES_7 <- c(
  "car_value",
  "salary_range",
  "debt_to_income_ratio",
  "loan_length",
  "repaid_loan_on_prev_car",
  "driver_tenure",
  "size_of_downpayment"
)

TARGET <- "repaid"
TRAIN_PROP <- 0.70
CV_METHOD <- "repeatedcv"
CV_FOLDS  <- 10
CV_REPEATS <- 3

# ---------------- Helpers ----------------
find_source <- function() {
  candidates <- c("data","data_transformed","data_work","data_clean","data_raw")
  for (nm in candidates) {
    if (exists(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
      obj <- get(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      if (is.data.frame(obj)) return(list(name = nm, df = obj))
    }
  }
  return(NULL)
}

coerce_binary <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) return(as.integer(x))
  sx <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  res <- ifelse(sx %in% c("1","true","t","yes","y"), 1,
         ifelse(sx %in% c("0","false","f","no","n"), 0, NA))
  if (all(is.na(res))) {
    res2 <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.numeric(x)))
    if (!all(is.na(res2))) return(res2)
  }
  res
}

extract_prob_vector <- function(prob_obj) {
  if (is.null(prob_obj)) return(NULL)
  if (is.numeric(prob_obj) && is.vector(prob_obj)) return(as.numeric(prob_obj))
  if (is.matrix(prob_obj)) prob_obj <- as.data.frame(prob_obj)
  if (is.data.frame(prob_obj)) {
    if ("Repaid" %in% colnames(prob_obj)) return(as.numeric(prob_obj[,"Repaid"]))
    # prefer second numeric (caret sometimes stores probs as two columns)
    numeric_cols <- colnames(prob_obj)[sapply(prob_obj, is.numeric)]
    if (length(numeric_cols) >= 2) return(as.numeric(prob_obj[[numeric_cols[2]]]))
    if (length(numeric_cols) == 1) return(as.numeric(prob_obj[[numeric_cols[1]]]))
  }
  NULL
}

calc_metrics_obj <- function(actual, pred, prob) {
  # actual, pred: character vectors; prob numeric vector for positive class
  actual_f <- factor(tolower(as.character(actual)))
  actual_norm <- ifelse(actual_f %in% c("1","true","yes","y","repaid","paid"), "Repaid",
                        ifelse(actual_f %in% c("0","false","no","n","not_repaid","notrepaid","not repaid"), "Not_Repaid", NA))
  actual_fac <- factor(actual_norm, levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))

  pred_fac <- NULL
  if (!is.null(pred)) {
    p <- factor(tolower(as.character(pred)))
    pnorm <- ifelse(p %in% c("1","true","yes","y","repaid","paid"), "Repaid",
                    ifelse(p %in% c("0","false","no","n","not_repaid","notrepaid"), "Not_Repaid", NA))
    pred_fac <- factor(pnorm, levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
  } else if (!is.null(prob)) {
    pred_fac <- factor(ifelse(prob >= 0.5, "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"), levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
  }

  cm <- NULL
  if (!is.null(pred_fac) && length(pred_fac) == length(actual_fac)) {
    cm <- tryCatch(caret::confusionMatrix(pred_fac, actual_fac, positive = "Repaid"), error = function(e) NULL)
  }
  roc_obj <- NULL
  auc_v <- NA_real_
  if (!is.null(prob) && length(prob) == length(actual_fac)) {
    roc_obj <- tryCatch(pROC::roc(response = as.numeric(actual_fac == "Repaid"), predictor = as.numeric(prob), quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(roc_obj)) auc_v <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_obj))
  }

  list(confusion = cm, roc = roc_obj, auc = auc_v)
}

# ---------------- Load source data ----------------
src_info <- find_source()
if (is.null(src_info)) stop("No data object found. Please load your dataset into 'data' or 'data_transformed' etc.")
src_df <- src_info$df
message("Using source object: ", src_info$name)

if (!(TARGET %in% names(src_df))) stop("Source dataset must contain target column named exactly: 'repaid'")

# ---------------- Prepare dataframe ----------------
features <- FEATURES_7[FEATURES_7 %in% names(src_df)]
if (length(features) < length(FEATURES_7)) {
  warning("Some configured features missing and will be ignored: ", paste(setdiff(FEATURES_7, features), collapse = ", "))
}
if (length(features) == 0) stop("No configured features found in source dataset.")

message("Using features: ", paste(features, collapse = ", "))

df <- src_df[, c(features, TARGET), drop = FALSE]

# safe conversions
if ("salary_range" %in% names(df)) df$salary_range <- as.factor(df$salary_range)
if ("repaid_loan_on_prev_car" %in% names(df)) df$repaid_loan_on_prev_car <- coerce_binary(df$repaid_loan_on_prev_car)
if ("size_of_downpayment" %in% names(df)) {
  df$size_of_downpayment <- as.character(df$size_of_downpayment)
  df$size_of_downpayment <- gsub("%","", df$size_of_downpayment)
  df$size_of_downpayment <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df$size_of_downpayment)/100)
}
if ("driver_tenure" %in% names(df)) df$driver_tenure <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df$driver_tenure))

# normalize target
if (is.numeric(df[[TARGET]]) || is.integer(df[[TARGET]])) {
  df[[TARGET]] <- factor(ifelse(df[[TARGET]] == 1, "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"), levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
} else {
  tmp <- tolower(trimws(as.character(df[[TARGET]])))
  df[[TARGET]] <- factor(ifelse(tmp %in% c("1","repaid","yes","y","true","paid"), "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"),
                         levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
}

# drop rows with NA in predictors or target
n_before <- nrow(df)
df <- df[complete.cases(df), , drop = FALSE]
n_after <- nrow(df)
message("Rows before NA drop: ", n_before, "  after: ", n_after)
if (n_after < 50) warning("Less than 50 rows remain after dropping NA. Results may be unstable.")

# ---------------- Train/test split (stratified) ----------------
set.seed(42)
idx <- createDataPartition(df[[TARGET]], p = TRAIN_PROP, list = FALSE)
train_data <- df[idx, , drop = FALSE]
test_data  <- df[-idx, , drop = FALSE]
message("Train rows: ", nrow(train_data), "  Test rows: ", nrow(test_data))

# ---------------- trainControl ----------------
train_control <- trainControl(
  method = CV_METHOD,
  number = CV_FOLDS,
  repeats = CV_REPEATS,
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
  savePredictions = "final",
  verboseIter = FALSE
)

# ---------------- 1) Logistic Regression ----------------
message("\n--- Logistic Regression (glm) ---")
dv <- dummyVars(~ ., data = train_data[, features, drop = FALSE], fullRank = TRUE)
train_x_mat <- predict(dv, newdata = train_data[, features, drop = FALSE])
test_x_mat  <- predict(dv, newdata = test_data[, features, drop = FALSE])

train_lr_df <- as.data.frame(train_x_mat, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
train_lr_df$repaid <- train_data[[TARGET]]
test_lr_df <- as.data.frame(test_x_mat, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
test_lr_df$repaid <- test_data[[TARGET]]

nzv <- nearZeroVar(train_lr_df %>% select(-repaid), saveMetrics = TRUE)
if (any(nzv$nzv)) {
  drop_cols <- rownames(nzv)[nzv$nzv]
  message("LR: dropping NZV columns: ", paste(drop_cols, collapse = ", "))
  train_lr_df <- train_lr_df %>% select(-all_of(drop_cols))
  test_lr_df  <- test_lr_df  %>% select(-all_of(drop_cols))
}

set.seed(42)
lr_fit <- train(repaid ~ ., data = train_lr_df,
                method = "glm", family = "binomial",
                trControl = train_control, metric = "ROC",
                preProcess = c("center","scale"))

# preds
lr_train_prob <- predict(lr_fit, newdata = train_lr_df, type = "prob")
lr_train_pred <- predict(lr_fit, newdata = train_lr_df, type = "raw")
lr_test_prob <- predict(lr_fit, newdata = test_lr_df, type = "prob")
lr_test_pred <- predict(lr_fit, newdata = test_lr_df, type = "raw")

# save preds
write.csv(data.frame(actual = as.character(test_lr_df$repaid),
                     pred = as.character(lr_test_pred),
                     prob_Repaid = extract_prob_vector(lr_test_prob)),
          file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_test_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(data.frame(actual = as.character(train_lr_df$repaid),
                     pred = as.character(lr_train_pred),
                     prob_Repaid = extract_prob_vector(lr_train_prob)),
          file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_train_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

vi_lr <- tryCatch(varImp(lr_fit, scale = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(vi_lr)) {
  vi_lr_df <- as.data.frame(vi_lr$importance); vi_lr_df$Feature <- rownames(vi_lr_df)
  imp_col <- if ("Overall" %in% colnames(vi_lr_df)) "Overall" else colnames(vi_lr_df)[sapply(vi_lr_df, is.numeric)][1]
  vi_lr_df <- vi_lr_df %>% mutate(Overall = as.numeric(.data[[imp_col]])) %>% select(Overall, Feature) %>% arrange(desc(Overall))
  write.csv(vi_lr_df, file.path(OUT_DIR, "lr_varimp.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}

# compute metrics objects for plotting later
lr_train_res <- calc_metrics_obj(as.character(train_lr_df$repaid), as.character(lr_train_pred), extract_prob_vector(lr_train_prob))
lr_test_res  <- calc_metrics_obj(as.character(test_lr_df$repaid),  as.character(lr_test_pred),  extract_prob_vector(lr_test_prob))

# ---------------- 2) Random Forest ----------------
message("\n--- Random Forest (rf) ---")
train_rf_df <- train_data[, c(features, TARGET), drop = FALSE]
test_rf_df  <- test_data[,  c(features, TARGET), drop = FALSE]

# coerce some columns numeric if needed
if ("repaid_loan_on_prev_car" %in% names(train_rf_df)) train_rf_df$repaid_loan_on_prev_car <- as.numeric(train_rf_df$repaid_loan_on_prev_car)
if ("repaid_loan_on_prev_car" %in% names(test_rf_df))  test_rf_df$repaid_loan_on_prev_car  <- as.numeric(test_rf_df$repaid_loan_on_prev_car)

preds_rf <- setdiff(names(train_rf_df), TARGET)
single_level <- sapply(preds_rf, function(p) length(unique(na.omit(train_rf_df[[p]]))) <= 1)
if (any(single_level)) {
  drop_p <- names(single_level)[single_level]
  message("RF: dropping single-level predictors: ", paste(drop_p, collapse = ", "))
  preds_rf <- setdiff(preds_rf, drop_p)
  train_rf_df <- train_rf_df[, c(preds_rf, TARGET), drop = FALSE]
  test_rf_df  <- test_rf_df[, c(intersect(c(preds_rf, TARGET), names(test_rf_df))), drop = FALSE]
}
if (length(preds_rf) == 0) stop("RF: no predictors left after pruning.")

mtry_try <- unique(pmin(length(preds_rf), c(2,3)))
tuneGrid_rf <- expand.grid(mtry = mtry_try)

set.seed(42)
rf_fit <- train(
  reformulate(preds_rf, response = TARGET),
  data = train_rf_df,
  method = "rf",
  metric = "ROC",
  trControl = train_control,
  tuneGrid = tuneGrid_rf,
  ntree = 200,
  importance = TRUE
)

rf_train_prob <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = train_rf_df, type = "prob")
rf_train_pred <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = train_rf_df, type = "raw")
rf_test_prob  <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = test_rf_df, type = "prob")
rf_test_pred  <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = test_rf_df, type = "raw")

write.csv(data.frame(actual = as.character(test_rf_df[[TARGET]]),
                     pred = as.character(rf_test_pred),
                     prob_Repaid = extract_prob_vector(rf_test_prob)),
          file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_test_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(data.frame(actual = as.character(train_rf_df[[TARGET]]),
                     pred = as.character(rf_train_pred),
                     prob_Repaid = extract_prob_vector(rf_train_prob)),
          file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_train_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

vi_rf <- tryCatch(varImp(rf_fit, scale = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(vi_rf)) {
  vi_rf_df <- as.data.frame(vi_rf$importance); vi_rf_df$Feature <- rownames(vi_rf_df)
  imp_col <- if ("Overall" %in% colnames(vi_rf_df)) "Overall" else colnames(vi_rf_df)[sapply(vi_rf_df, is.numeric)][1]
  vi_rf_df <- vi_rf_df %>% mutate(Overall = as.numeric(.data[[imp_col]])) %>% select(Overall, Feature) %>% arrange(desc(Overall))
  write.csv(vi_rf_df, file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_varimp.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}

rf_train_res <- calc_metrics_obj(as.character(train_rf_df[[TARGET]]), as.character(rf_train_pred), extract_prob_vector(rf_train_prob))
rf_test_res  <- calc_metrics_obj(as.character(test_rf_df[[TARGET]]),  as.character(rf_test_pred),  extract_prob_vector(rf_test_prob))

# ---------------- 3) XGBoost ----------------
message("\n--- XGBoost (xgbTree) ---")
train_xgb_df <- train_data[, c(features, TARGET), drop = FALSE]
test_xgb_df  <- test_data[,  c(features, TARGET), drop = FALSE]

# convert ordered factors to numeric
for (cn in names(train_xgb_df)) if (cn != TARGET && is.ordered(train_xgb_df[[cn]])) train_xgb_df[[cn]] <- as.numeric(train_xgb_df[[cn]])
for (cn in names(test_xgb_df))  if (cn != TARGET && is.ordered(test_xgb_df[[cn]]))  test_xgb_df[[cn]]  <- as.numeric(test_xgb_df[[cn]])

tune_grid_xgb <- expand.grid(
  nrounds = c(100, 200),
  max_depth = c(3, 6),
  eta = c(0.01, 0.1),
  gamma = 0,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  min_child_weight = 1,
  subsample = 0.8
)

set.seed(42)
xgb_fit <- train(
  reformulate(setdiff(names(train_xgb_df), TARGET), TARGET),
  data = train_xgb_df,
  method = "xgbTree",
  trControl = train_control,
  tuneGrid = tune_grid_xgb,
  metric = "ROC",
  verbosity = 0
)

xgb_train_prob <- predict(xgb_fit, newdata = train_xgb_df, type = "prob")
xgb_train_pred <- predict(xgb_fit, newdata = train_xgb_df, type = "raw")
xgb_test_prob  <- predict(xgb_fit, newdata = test_xgb_df, type = "prob")
xgb_test_pred  <- predict(xgb_fit, newdata = test_xgb_df, type = "raw")

write.csv(data.frame(actual = as.character(test_xgb_df[[TARGET]]),
                     pred = as.character(xgb_test_pred),
                     prob_Repaid = extract_prob_vector(xgb_test_prob)),
          file.path(OUT_DIR, "xgb_test_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(data.frame(actual = as.character(train_xgb_df[[TARGET]]),
                     pred = as.character(xgb_train_pred),
                     prob_Repaid = extract_prob_vector(xgb_train_prob)),
          file.path(OUT_DIR, "xgb_train_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

vi_xgb <- tryCatch(varImp(xgb_fit, scale = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(vi_xgb)) {
  vi_xgb_df <- as.data.frame(vi_xgb$importance); vi_xgb_df$Feature <- rownames(vi_xgb_df)
  imp_col <- if ("Overall" %in% colnames(vi_xgb_df)) "Overall" else colnames(vi_xgb_df)[sapply(vi_xgb_df, is.numeric)][1]
  vi_xgb_df <- vi_xgb_df %>% mutate(Overall = as.numeric(.data[[imp_col]])) %>% select(Overall, Feature) %>% arrange(desc(Overall))
  write.csv(vi_xgb_df, file.path(OUT_DIR, "xgb_varimp.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}

xgb_train_res <- calc_metrics_obj(as.character(train_xgb_df[[TARGET]]), as.character(xgb_train_pred), extract_prob_vector(xgb_train_prob))
xgb_test_res  <- calc_metrics_obj(as.character(test_xgb_df[[TARGET]]),  as.character(xgb_test_pred),  extract_prob_vector(xgb_test_prob))

# ---------------- Combine & Save metrics ----------------
metrics_list <- list(
  LR_TRAIN = if(!is.null(lr_train_res$confusion)) lr_train_res$auc else NA,
  LR_TEST  = if(!is.null(lr_test_res$confusion))  lr_test_res$auc  else NA,
  RF_TRAIN = if(!is.null(rf_train_res$confusion)) rf_train_res$auc else NA,
  RF_TEST  = if(!is.null(rf_test_res$confusion))  rf_test_res$auc  else NA,
  XGB_TRAIN= if(!is.null(xgb_train_res$confusion)) xgb_train_res$auc else NA,
  XGB_TEST = if(!is.null(xgb_test_res$confusion))  xgb_test_res$auc  else NA
)

# assemble a printable tibble (one row per model/set)
rows <- list(
  tibble(Model = "LR", Set = "TRAIN", Accuracy = if(!is.null(lr_train_res$confusion)) as.numeric(lr_train_res$confusion$overall["Accuracy"]) else NA, AUC = lr_train_res$auc),
  tibble(Model = "LR", Set = "TEST",  Accuracy = if(!is.null(lr_test_res$confusion))  as.numeric(lr_test_res$confusion$overall["Accuracy"]) else NA, AUC = lr_test_res$auc),
  tibble(Model = "RF", Set = "TRAIN", Accuracy = if(!is.null(rf_train_res$confusion)) as.numeric(rf_train_res$confusion$overall["Accuracy"]) else NA, AUC = rf_train_res$auc),
  tibble(Model = "RF", Set = "TEST",  Accuracy = if(!is.null(rf_test_res$confusion))  as.numeric(rf_test_res$confusion$overall["Accuracy"]) else NA, AUC = rf_test_res$auc),
  tibble(Model = "XGB",Set = "TRAIN", Accuracy = if(!is.null(xgb_train_res$confusion)) as.numeric(xgb_train_res$confusion$overall["Accuracy"]) else NA, AUC = xgb_train_res$auc),
  tibble(Model = "XGB",Set = "TEST",  Accuracy = if(!is.null(xgb_test_res$confusion))  as.numeric(xgb_test_res$confusion$overall["Accuracy"]) else NA, AUC = xgb_test_res$auc)
)
metrics_all <- bind_rows(rows)
write.csv(metrics_all, file.path(OUT_DIR, "combined_models_metrics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
message("Saved combined metrics to: ", file.path(OUT_DIR, "combined_models_metrics.csv"))

# ---------------- Immediate ROC plotting to R Plot panel ----------------
cat("\n=== Plotting ROC curves to R Plot panel ===\n")
roc_items <- list(
  LR = if (!is.null(lr_test_res$roc)) list(roc = lr_test_res$roc, auc = lr_test_res$auc) else NULL,
  RF = if (!is.null(rf_test_res$roc)) list(roc = rf_test_res$roc, auc = rf_test_res$auc) else NULL,
  XGB= if (!is.null(xgb_test_res$roc)) list(roc = xgb_test_res$roc, auc = xgb_test_res$auc) else NULL
)
roc_items <- Filter(Negate(is.null), roc_items)

if (length(roc_items) == 0) {
  cat("No ROC objects available for test sets. Ensure test predictions & prob vectors exist.\n")
} else {
  first_name <- names(roc_items)[1]
  plot(roc_items[[first_name]]$roc, col = "#1b9e77", lwd = 2, main = "ROC Curves Comparison (Test Sets)", legacy.axes = TRUE)
  if (length(roc_items) > 1) {
    colors <- c("#1b9e77","#d95f02","#7570b3")
    idx <- 1
    for (nm in names(roc_items)) {
      if (idx == 1) { idx <- idx + 1; next } # already drawn first
      plot(roc_items[[nm]]$roc, add = TRUE, col = colors[idx], lwd = 2)
      idx <- idx + 1
    }
  }
  # Legend
  legend_labels <- sapply(names(roc_items), function(nm) {
    auc_v <- tryCatch(auc(roc_items[[nm]]$roc), error = function(e) NA)
    sprintf("%s (AUC=%.4f)", nm, ifelse(is.na(auc_v), NA, round(auc_v, 4)))
  })
  legend("bottomright", legend = legend_labels, col = c("#1b9e77","#d95f02","#7570b3")[1:length(legend_labels)], lwd = 2, cex = 0.9)
  abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "gray")
  cat("ROC curves plotted on Plot panel.\n")
}

message("\nPipeline finished. All outputs (predictions, varimp, metrics) are in:", normalizePath(OUT_DIR))

```


6.4 Variable Importance Comparison
```{r}
# ============================================================================
# Variable Importance Comparison (robust version, English)
# ============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(gridExtra)
  library(dplyr)
})

cat("\n=== Variable Importance Comparison ===\n")

# Output directory (reuse OUT_DIR if it exists)
OUT_DIR <- if (exists("OUT_DIR")) OUT_DIR else file.path(getwd(), "model_outputs")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper 1: attempt to get varimp from environment objects
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
try_get_varimp_env <- function(names_vec) {
  for (nm in names_vec) {
    if (exists(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
      obj <- get(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      if (is.data.frame(obj) && nrow(obj) > 0) {
        return(obj)
      }
    }
  }
  return(NULL)
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper 2: attempt to read varimp from CSV in OUT_DIR
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
try_get_varimp_csv <- function(prefix) {
  f <- file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(prefix, "_varimp.csv"))
  if (file.exists(f)) {
    df <- tryCatch(read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(df) && nrow(df) > 0) return(df)
  }
  return(NULL)
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper 3: normalize caret::varImp or CSV outputs to standard format:
# returns data.frame with columns: Feature, Importance
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
normalize_varimp_df <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)
  
  # find numeric columns (importance candidates)
  numeric_cols <- names(df)[sapply(df, is.numeric)]
  if (length(numeric_cols) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # prefer "Overall" if present
  imp_col <- if ("Overall" %in% names(df)) "Overall" else numeric_cols[1]
  
  # find feature column
  if ("Feature" %in% names(df)) {
    feat_col <- "Feature"
  } else if (!is.null(rownames(df)) && any(rownames(df) != "")) {
    df$Feature <- rownames(df)
    feat_col <- "Feature"
  } else {
    # no feature column found, cannot normalize
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  df2 <- df %>% select(Feature, all_of(imp_col))
  colnames(df2) <- c("Feature", "Importance")
  df2 <- df2 %>% arrange(desc(Importance))
  return(df2)
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper 4: plotting function (top 15)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
make_varimp_plot <- function(df, title, color="#0072B2") {
  if (is.null(df) || !all(c("Feature","Importance") %in% names(df))) return(NULL)
  df_plot <- head(df, 15)
  ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = reorder(Feature, Importance), y = Importance)) +
    geom_col(fill = color) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = title, x = "Feature", y = "Importance") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 1: try to obtain varimp tables for LR, RF, XGB
# Priority: environment objects -> CSVs in OUT_DIR
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Logistic regression varimp (try environment names commonly used)
vi_lr <- try_get_varimp_env(c("vi_lr_df", "var_imp_logit", "vi_lr", "lr_varimp_df"))
if (is.null(vi_lr)) vi_lr <- try_get_varimp_csv("lr")
vi_lr <- normalize_varimp_df(vi_lr)

# Random forest varimp
vi_rf <- try_get_varimp_env(c("vi_rf_df", "var_imp_rf", "vi_rf", "rf_varimp_df"))
if (is.null(vi_rf)) vi_rf <- try_get_varimp_csv("rf")
vi_rf <- normalize_varimp_df(vi_rf)

# XGBoost varimp
vi_xgb <- try_get_varimp_env(c("vi_xgb_df", "var_imp_xgb", "vi_xgb", "xgb_varimp_df"))
if (is.null(vi_xgb)) vi_xgb <- try_get_varimp_csv("xgb")
vi_xgb <- normalize_varimp_df(vi_xgb)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 2: create plots for existing varimp tables
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
plots <- list()
if (!is.null(vi_lr))  plots[["Logistic Regression"]] <- make_varimp_plot(vi_lr,  "Logistic Regression", "#e74c3c")
if (!is.null(vi_rf))  plots[["Random Forest"]]       <- make_varimp_plot(vi_rf,  "Random Forest",       "#3498db")
if (!is.null(vi_xgb)) plots[["XGBoost"]]             <- make_varimp_plot(vi_xgb, "XGBoost",             "#2ecc71")

# filter out NULL plots
plots <- Filter(Negate(is.null), plots)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 3: print/arrange plots to R plotting pane
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (length(plots) == 0) {
  cat("No variable importance found — skipping plot.\n")
} else if (length(plots) == 1) {
  print(plots[[1]])
} else {
  ncol_val <- ifelse(length(plots) == 2, 2, 3)
  do.call(grid.arrange, c(plots, ncol = ncol_val))
}

cat("✓ Variable importance comparison plotted.\n")

```

7. Model Comparison Summary

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# COMPREHENSIVE MODEL COMPARISON (ROBUST ENGLISH VERSION)
# ============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
})

cat("\n=== Comprehensive Model Comparison ===\n")

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Output directory
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
save_dir <- if (exists("save_dir")) save_dir else "model_outputs"
dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Try loading metrics from environment variables or CSVs
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
metrics_df <- NULL

# Priority: environment objects
env_candidates <- c("metrics_all","all_metrics","comparison_df",
                    "metrics_tbl","metrics_summary","results_list")

for (nm in env_candidates) {
  if (exists(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    obj <- get(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)

    # If data frame / tibble -> use directly
    if (is.data.frame(obj) || is_tibble(obj)) {
      if (nrow(obj) > 0) {
        metrics_df <- as.data.frame(obj)
        break
      }
    }

    # If list of metric vectors -> convert
    if (is.list(obj) && length(obj) > 0) {
      metrics_df <- bind_rows(lapply(names(obj), function(nm2) {
        vals <- obj[[nm2]]
        tibble(
          Model = nm2,
          Accuracy = as.numeric(vals["Accuracy"]),
          Sensitivity = as.numeric(vals["Sensitivity"]),
          Specificity = as.numeric(vals["Specificity"]),
          Precision = as.numeric(vals["Precision"]),
          F1_Score = as.numeric(vals["F1_Score"]),
          AUC = as.numeric(vals["ROC_AUC"])
        )
      }))
      break
    }
  }
}

# If still missing, try reading from CSVs in output directory
if (is.null(metrics_df)) {
  csv_candidates <- c(
    "combined_models_metrics.csv",
    "all_models_metrics.csv",
    "models_comparison_metrics.csv"
  )
  for (f in csv_candidates) {
    fp <- file.path(save_dir, f)
    if (file.exists(fp)) {
      metrics_df <- read.csv(fp, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
      break
    }
  }
}

# If still not found → STOP
if (is.null(metrics_df) || nrow(metrics_df) == 0) {
  stop("No metrics table found in environment or CSV. Please run the model evaluation first.")
}

cat("✓ Loaded metrics table.\n")

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Clean / normalize column names
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
names(metrics_df) <- make.names(names(metrics_df))

# Use Model column or fallback to rownames
if (!"Model" %in% names(metrics_df)) {
  if (!is.null(rownames(metrics_df))) {
    metrics_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(metrics_df, "Model")
  } else {
    metrics_df$Model <- paste0("Model_", seq_len(nrow(metrics_df)))
  }
}

# Fix AUC column name
if (!"AUC" %in% names(metrics_df) && "ROC_AUC" %in% names(metrics_df)) {
  metrics_df$AUC <- metrics_df$ROC_AUC
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Keep key numeric metrics
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
key_cols <- c("Accuracy","AUC","F1_Score","Sensitivity",
              "Specificity","Precision","Kappa","Avg_Rank")
present_keys <- intersect(key_cols, names(metrics_df))
metrics_df <- metrics_df %>% select(Model, all_of(present_keys))

# Convert all numeric fields safely
for (col in names(metrics_df)) {
  if (col != "Model") {
    metrics_df[[col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(metrics_df[[col]]))
  }
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Print main performance table
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n", strrep("=", 80), "\n", sep="")
cat("COMPREHENSIVE MODEL COMPARISON SUMMARY\n")
cat(strrep("=", 80), "\n\n", sep="")

cat("1) PERFORMANCE METRICS\n")
cat(strrep("-", 60), "\n", sep="")
print(metrics_df, row.names = FALSE, digits = 4)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Rankings per metric
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n2) RANKINGS BY METRIC\n")
cat(strrep("-", 60), "\n", sep="")

rank_metrics <- intersect(c("Accuracy","AUC","F1_Score",
                            "Sensitivity","Specificity","Precision"),
                          names(metrics_df))

if (length(rank_metrics) == 0) {
  cat("  No ranking metrics available.\n")
} else {
  for (m in rank_metrics) {
    cat("\n", m, " ranking:\n", sep="")
    cat(strrep("-", 40), "\n", sep="")

    ranked <- metrics_df %>% arrange(desc(.data[[m]]))
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(ranked))) {
      val <- ranked[[m]][i]
      val_str <- ifelse(is.na(val), "NA", sprintf("%.4f", val))
      cat(sprintf("  %2d. %-10s : %s\n", i, ranked$Model[i], val_str))
    }
  }
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Find Overall Best Model by average rank
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n3) OVERALL BEST MODEL (Average Rank)\n")
cat(strrep("-", 60), "\n", sep="")

metrics_for_avg <- intersect(c("Accuracy","AUC","F1_Score"), names(metrics_df))

if (length(metrics_for_avg) == 0) {
  cat("  Not enough metrics for average rank.\n")
  overall_winner <- NA
} else {
  rank_matrix <- sapply(metrics_for_avg, function(col) {
    v <- metrics_df[[col]]
    v2 <- v
    # NAs ranked worst
    v2[is.na(v2)] <- min(v, na.rm=TRUE) - 1
    rank(-v2)
  })

  metrics_df$Avg_Rank <- rowMeans(rank_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)

  winner_index <- which.min(metrics_df$Avg_Rank)
  overall_winner <- metrics_df$Model[winner_index]

  cat(sprintf("  Winner: %s (Avg Rank = %.3f)\n",
              overall_winner, metrics_df$Avg_Rank[winner_index]))

  cat("\n  Full average-rank table:\n")
  print(metrics_df %>% select(Model, Avg_Rank) %>% arrange(Avg_Rank),
        row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Detailed statistics per model
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n4) DETAILED STATISTICS PER MODEL\n")
cat(strrep("-", 60), "\n", sep="")

for (i in seq_len(nrow(metrics_df))) {
  row <- metrics_df[i, ]
  cat("\nModel:", row$Model, "\n")
  for (col in names(row)) {
    if (col == "Model") next
    val <- row[[col]]
    if (is.na(val)) {
      cat(sprintf("  %-12s: NA\n", col))
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("  %-12s: %.4f\n", col, val))
    }
  }
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Recommendations
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n5) RECOMMENDATIONS\n")
cat(strrep("-", 60), "\n", sep="")

if (!is.na(overall_winner)) {
  cat(sprintf("  • Overall Recommended Model: %s (by average rank)\n", overall_winner))
}

for (m in c("Accuracy","AUC","F1_Score")) {
  if (m %in% names(metrics_df) && !all(is.na(metrics_df[[m]]))) {
    best_idx <- which.max(metrics_df[[m]])
    cat(sprintf("  • Best by %-10s : %s (%.4f)\n",
                m, metrics_df$Model[best_idx], metrics_df[[m]][best_idx]))
  }
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Save results
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
out_file <- file.path(save_dir, "model_comparison_summary.csv")
write.csv(metrics_df, out_file, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nSaved model comparison summary to:\n", normalizePath(out_file), "\n\n", sep="")

cat(strrep("=", 80), "\n", sep="")
cat("✓ MODEL COMPARISON SUMMARY COMPLETE\n")
cat(strrep("=", 80), "\n", sep="")

```

# ============================================================================
# Performance Metrics Comparison Visualization (robust, single block)
# ============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)

})

# Output directory
OUT_DIR <- if (exists("save_dir")) save_dir else "model_outputs"
dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Ensure all_metrics exists (try to load from environment or CSV)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (!exists("all_metrics")) {

  cand_files <- c(file.path(OUT_DIR, "models_comparison_metrics.csv"),
                  file.path(OUT_DIR, "combined_models_metrics.csv"),
                  file.path(OUT_DIR, "all_models_metrics.csv"))
  loaded <- FALSE
  for (f in cand_files) {
    if (file.exists(f)) {
      all_metrics <- tryCatch(read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE),
                              error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(all_metrics)) {
        loaded <- TRUE
        message("Loaded metrics from: ", f)
        break
      }
    }
  }
  if (!loaded) stop("all_metrics not found in environment and no common CSV located in '", OUT_DIR, "'.")
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Select and normalize metric columns
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
required_cols <- c("Model", "Accuracy", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "Precision", "F1_Score", "AUC")

# If names differ slightly, try to match common alternatives
col_map <- names(all_metrics)
lower_names <- tolower(col_map)
col_aliases <- list(
  Model = c("model", "Model"),
  Accuracy = c("accuracy", "acc"),
  Sensitivity = c("sensitivity", "recall", "tp.rate"),
  Specificity = c("specificity", "tn.rate"),
  Precision = c("precision", "ppv"),
  F1_Score = c("f1", "f1_score", "f1.score"),
  AUC = c("auc", "roc_auc", "roc.aud", "roc_auc")
)

# build a safe mapping from wanted -> actual column name (if present)
mapped_cols <- list()
for (std in names(col_aliases)) {
  found <- NA_character_
  for (alias in col_aliases[[std]]) {
    idx <- which(tolower(col_map) == tolower(alias))
    if (length(idx) > 0) { found <- col_map[idx[1]]; break }
  }
  # also accept exact match by std name
  if (is.na(found) && std %in% col_map) found <- std
  mapped_cols[[std]] <- found
}

# check model column
if (is.na(mapped_cols$Model)) {
  # try to use rownames as Model
  if (!is.null(rownames(all_metrics))) {
    all_metrics <- tibble::rownames_to_column(all_metrics, "Model")
    mapped_cols$Model <- "Model"
  } else {
    stop("Could not find a 'Model' column in all_metrics.")
  }
}

# Build tidy df with chosen cols (keep those available)
use_cols <- c()
for (std in names(mapped_cols)) {
  if (!is.na(mapped_cols[[std]])) use_cols <- c(use_cols, mapped_cols[[std]])
}
# ensure Model present
use_cols <- unique(c(mapped_cols$Model, setdiff(use_cols, mapped_cols$Model)))

metrics_tbl <- all_metrics %>% select(all_of(use_cols))

# rename to standard names
rename_map <- setNames(names(mapped_cols)[!is.na(mapped_cols)], unlist(mapped_cols[!is.na(mapped_cols)]))
metrics_tbl <- metrics_tbl %>% rename(!!!rlang::set_names(names(rename_map), rename_map))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Ensure numeric and clamp / keep NA
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
num_cols <- setdiff(names(metrics_tbl), "Model")
for (c in num_cols) {
  metrics_tbl[[c]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(metrics_tbl[[c]]))
  # do not coerce NA -> 0; keep NA so bars won't show label
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Reshape for plotting (long)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
metrics_long <- metrics_tbl %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Model, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = factor(Metric, levels = c("Accuracy", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "Precision", "F1_Score", "AUC")),
    Label = ifelse(is.na(Value), "", sprintf("%.3f", Value))
  )

# remove any Metric that is entirely NA for all models (optional)
metrics_long <- metrics_long %>%
  group_by(Metric) %>%
  filter(!all(is.na(Value))) %>%
  ungroup()

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Plot: dodge bar, labels hidden when NA, coord_cartesian for limits
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# pick colors dynamically if number of unique models > 3
models <- unique(metrics_long$Model)
palette_default <- c("#e74c3c", "#3498db", "#2ecc71", "#f39c12", "#9b59b6", "#16a085")
cols_use <- rep(palette_default, length.out = length(models))[1:length(models)]
names(cols_use) <- models

p <- ggplot(metrics_long, aes(x = Metric, y = Value, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.75, alpha = 0.9, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_use) +
  labs(
    title = "Model Performance Metrics Comparison",
    subtitle = "Comparison across key evaluation metrics",
    x = "Metric",
    y = "Value",
    fill = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Label),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 3, na.rm = TRUE) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.05)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1), limits = c(0, 1.05), expand = c(0, 0))

print(p)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Save plot
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
out_plot <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "metrics_comparison.png")
ggsave(out_plot, plot = p, width = 9, height = 5.5, dpi = 150)
message("Saved metrics comparison plot to: ", normalizePath(out_plot))

8.2 Confusion Matrix Heatmaps
```{r}
# ============================================================================
# Confusion Matrix Heatmaps - Robust & Complete
# - Will try multiple ways to obtain confusion matrices:
#   1) existing caret::confusionMatrix objects in environment
#   2) objects named cm_<model>, <model>_cm, <model>_eval$cm, etc.
#   3) CSV prediction files in "model_outputs" or "rf_outputs_light_precise_cv10" etc.
#   4) environment prediction variables (lr_pred_class, rf_pred_class, xgb_pred_class)
#   5) if test_data exists and preds exist, reconstruct confusion matrix
# - Produces 1-3 heatmaps (LR, RF, XGB) if available, arranges and saves PNG.
# ============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(gridExtra)
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(caret)   # for confusionMatrix class
})

# Output directory
OUT_DIR <- if (exists("OUT_DIR")) OUT_DIR else if (exists("save_dir")) save_dir else "model_outputs"
dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: Normalize confusion matrix-like input to tidy df:
# returns data.frame with columns: Prediction, Reference, Freq
# Accepts: caret::confusionMatrix, table, matrix, data.frame (Prediction,Reference,Freq)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
cm_to_df <- function(cm_in) {
  if (is.null(cm_in)) return(NULL)

  # caret::confusionMatrix object
  if (inherits(cm_in, "confusionMatrix")) {
    tbl <- as.table(cm_in$table)
  } else if (is.table(cm_in) || is.matrix(cm_in)) {
    tbl <- as.table(cm_in)
  } else if (is.data.frame(cm_in) &&
             all(c("Prediction","Reference","Freq") %in% colnames(cm_in))) {
    df <- cm_in %>% mutate(Reference = as.character(Reference),
                           Prediction = as.character(Prediction),
                           Freq = as.numeric(Freq))
    return(df)
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }

  df <- as.data.frame(tbl, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  # For tables created by caret, row = Prediction, col = Reference
  if (ncol(df) >= 3) {
    names(df)[1:3] <- c("Prediction", "Reference", "Freq")
    df$Prediction <- as.character(df$Prediction)
    df$Reference  <- as.character(df$Reference)
    df$Freq       <- as.numeric(df$Freq)
    # preserve ordering
    df$Reference <- factor(df$Reference, levels = unique(df$Reference))
    df$Prediction <- factor(df$Prediction, levels = unique(df$Prediction))
    return(df)
  }
  return(NULL)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: build confusionMatrix object from actual & predicted vectors
# returns caret::confusionMatrix object (or NULL)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
make_cm_from_vectors <- function(actual, predicted) {
  if (is.null(actual) || is.null(predicted)) return(NULL)
  if (length(actual) != length(predicted)) return(NULL)
  # normalize labels
  norm <- function(v) {
    vc <- tolower(trimws(as.character(v)))
    vc[vc %in% c("1","true","yes","y","repaid","paid")] <- "Repaid"
    vc[vc %in% c("0","false","no","n","not_repaid","notrepaid")] <- "Not_Repaid"
    f <- factor(ifelse(vc == "Repaid","Repaid", ifelse(vc == "Not_Repaid","Not_Repaid", NA)),
                levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
    return(f)
  }
  a <- norm(actual)
  p <- norm(predicted)
  if (all(is.na(a)) || all(is.na(p))) return(NULL)
  # drop rows with NA in actual
  ok <- !is.na(a)
  a <- a[ok]; p <- p[ok]
  if (length(a) < 1) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(confusionMatrix(p, a, positive = "Repaid"), error = function(e) NULL)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Try to find confusion matrices in environment using many common names
# Returns named list: list("Logistic Regression" = cm_obj, ...)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
find_cm_in_env <- function() {
  res <- list()
  # model name keys -> candidate expressions / names
  candidates <- list(
    "Logistic Regression" = c("logit_eval$cm","logit_eval$confusion","logit_cm","cm_logit","cm_lr","lr_cm","lr_eval$cm","logit_conf"),
    "Random Forest"       = c("rf_eval$cm","rf_eval$confusion","rf_cm","cm_rf","cm_rf_eval","rf_conf","rf_cm_obj"),
    "XGBoost"             = c("xgb_eval$cm","xgb_eval$confusion","xgb_cm","cm_xgb","cm_xgboost","xgb_conf")
  )

  for (model in names(candidates)) {
    found <- NULL
    for (expr in candidates[[model]]) {
      # handle expressions with $ (like obj$cm)
      if (grepl("\\$", expr)) {
        parts <- strsplit(expr, "\\$")[[1]]
        obj_name <- parts[1]; field <- parts[2]
        if (exists(obj_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
          obj <- get(obj_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)
          if (!is.null(obj) && !is.null(obj[[field]])) {
            cand <- obj[[field]]
            cm_df <- tryCatch(cm_to_df(cand), error = function(e) NULL)
            if (!is.null(cm_df)) { found <- cand; break }
            # also accept caret confusionMatrix objects
            if (inherits(cand, "confusionMatrix")) { found <- cand; break }
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (exists(expr, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
          cand <- get(expr, envir = .GlobalEnv)
          if (!is.null(cand)) {
            cm_df <- tryCatch(cm_to_df(cand), error = function(e) NULL)
            if (!is.null(cm_df) || inherits(cand, "confusionMatrix")) { found <- cand; break }
            # maybe it's a table/matrix in env
            if (is.table(cand) || is.matrix(cand)) { found <- cand; break }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    if (!is.null(found)) res[[model]] <- found
  }
  return(res)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Try to read common CSV preds to reconstruct confusion matrices
# Look into OUT_DIR and other likely folders
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
find_cm_from_csvs <- function(out_dirs = c(OUT_DIR, "model_lr_outputs", "rf_outputs_light_precise_cv10", "rf_outputs_light")) {
  res <- list()
  files_checked <- c()
  for (d in unique(out_dirs)) {
    if (!dir.exists(d)) next
    # common filenames
    cand_files <- list.files(d, pattern = "pred|prediction|preds|test.*pred|test.*prob", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
    for (f in cand_files) {
      if (f %in% files_checked) next
      files_checked <- c(files_checked, f)
      df <- tryCatch(read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(df)) next
      cn <- tolower(colnames(df))
      # heuristics: find actual / pred class / prob columns
      actual_idx <- which(grepl("^actual$|^y$|^label$|^truth$|target|reference", cn))
      pred_idx   <- which(grepl("pred.*class|predicted|^pred$|^class$|prediction", cn))
      prob_idx   <- which(grepl("prob|probability|pred_prob|repaid_prob|prob_repaid", cn))
      if (length(actual_idx) == 0) {
        # fallback: try columns named 'repaid' or second-last/last column common
        actual_idx <- which(cn %in% c("repaid","label","y"))
      }
      # if we have actual + pred/class, build cm
      if (length(actual_idx) > 0 && length(pred_idx) > 0) {
        actual_col <- df[[actual_idx[1]]]
        pred_col   <- df[[pred_idx[1]]]
        cm_obj <- make_cm_from_vectors(actual_col, pred_col)
        if (!is.null(cm_obj)) {
          # decide model name from filename
          nm <- if (grepl("lr|logit", f, ignore.case = TRUE)) "Logistic Regression" else if (grepl("rf|random", f, ignore.case = TRUE)) "Random Forest" else if (grepl("xgb|xgboost", f, ignore.case = TRUE)) "XGBoost" else basename(f)
          res[[nm]] <- cm_obj
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return(res)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Try to build confusion matrices from available prediction variables in env:
# e.g., lr_pred_class, rf_pred_class, xgb_pred_class and test_data$repaid
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
find_cm_from_env_preds <- function() {
  res <- list()
  models_map <- list(
    "Logistic Regression" = c("lr_pred_class","lr_pred","logit_pred_class","logit_pred"),
    "Random Forest" = c("rf_pred_class","rf_pred","rf_pred_class"),
    "XGBoost" = c("xgb_pred_class","xgb_pred","xg_pred")
  )
  for (model in names(models_map)) {
    pred_obj <- NULL
    for (nm in models_map[[model]]) {
      if (exists(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)) { pred_obj <- get(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv); break }
    }
    # find prob optionally
    prob_obj <- NULL
    for (nm in c(paste0(names(models_map[[model]]), "_prob"), paste0(names(models_map[[model]]), "_probability"))) {
      if (exists(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)) { prob_obj <- get(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv); break }
    }
    # actual from test_data if exists
    actual <- NULL
    if (exists("test_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
      td <- get("test_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)
      if ("repaid" %in% names(td)) actual <- td$repaid
    }
    # fallback: global 'test' object
    if (is.null(actual) && exists("test", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
      td <- get("test", envir = .GlobalEnv)
      if ("repaid" %in% names(td)) actual <- td$repaid
    }

    if (!is.null(pred_obj) && !is.null(actual)) {
      cm_obj <- make_cm_from_vectors(actual, pred_obj)
      if (!is.null(cm_obj)) res[[model]] <- cm_obj
    }
  }
  return(res)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Gather confusion matrices using multiple strategies
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("Searching for confusion matrices in environment...\n")
cm_env <- find_cm_in_env()
if (length(cm_env) > 0) {
  cat("  Found confusion matrices in environment: ", paste(names(cm_env), collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

cat("Searching for CSV prediction files in output folders...\n")
cm_csv <- find_cm_from_csvs(c(OUT_DIR, "model_lr_outputs", "rf_outputs_light_precise_cv10", "rf_outputs_light"))

if (length(cm_csv) > 0) {
  cat("  Reconstructed confusion matrices from CSVs: ", paste(names(cm_csv), collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

cat("Searching for prediction objects in environment to reconstruct CM...\n")
cm_env_preds <- find_cm_from_env_preds()
if (length(cm_env_preds) > 0) {
  cat("  Reconstructed confusion matrices from env preds: ", paste(names(cm_env_preds), collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# Merge results, favor env-found direct objects first, then csv, then env preds
cm_all <- list()
for (nm in c("Logistic Regression","Random Forest","XGBoost")) {
  if (!is.null(cm_env[[nm]])) cm_all[[nm]] <- cm_env[[nm]]
  else if (!is.null(cm_csv[[nm]])) cm_all[[nm]] <- cm_csv[[nm]]
  else if (!is.null(cm_env_preds[[nm]])) cm_all[[nm]] <- cm_env_preds[[nm]]
}

# If still empty, try to be more permissive: include any named results from cm_csv / cm_env that aren't standard
if (length(cm_all) == 0) {
  # take whatever we can from cm_env or cm_csv
  combined_candidates <- c(cm_env, cm_csv, cm_env_preds)
  if (length(combined_candidates) > 0) {
    cm_all <- combined_candidates
    cat("  Using generic found confusion matrices: ", paste(names(cm_all), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
}

if (length(cm_all) == 0) {
  message("\nNo confusion matrices could be located or reconstructed.")
  message("Tried: environment objects (many common names), CSV prediction files in output folders, and prediction variables + test_data.")
  message("To proceed, provide one of: logit_eval$cm, rf_eval$cm, xgb_eval$cm, cm_logit, cm_rf, cm_xgb, or place prediction CSVs in ", normalizePath(OUT_DIR))
  # graceful exit (no error)
  quit(save = "no", status = 0)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create heatmap plot function (uses cm_to_df)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
plot_cm_heatmap_safe <- function(cm_obj, title) {
  df <- cm_to_df(cm_obj)
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

  # ensure order: Reference (actual) on x axis, Prediction on y axis
  ref_levels <- unique(df$Reference)
  pred_levels <- unique(df$Prediction)
  df$Reference <- factor(df$Reference, levels = ref_levels)
  df$Prediction <- factor(df$Prediction, levels = pred_levels)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Reference, y = Prediction, fill = Freq)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = Freq), size = 6, fontface = "bold", na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#3498db", na.value = "grey90") +
    labs(title = title, x = "Actual", y = "Predicted") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
  return(p)
}

# Build plots for available models
plot_list <- list()
for (nm in names(cm_all)) {
  p <- tryCatch(plot_cm_heatmap_safe(cm_all[[nm]], nm), error = function(e) { warning("plot failed for ", nm, ": ", e$message); NULL })
  if (!is.null(p)) plot_list[[nm]] <- p
}

if (length(plot_list) == 0) {
  message("No valid heatmap plots could be generated from the found confusion matrices.")
  quit(save = "no", status = 0)
}

# Arrange & display
n_plots <- length(plot_list)
ncol_val <- ifelse(n_plots >= 3, 3, n_plots)
grid.arrange(grobs = plot_list, ncol = ncol_val)

# Save PNG
out_file <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "confusion_matrices_heatmap.png")
png(out_file, width = 480 * ncol_val, height = 480, res = 120)
grid.arrange(grobs = plot_list, ncol = ncol_val)
dev.off()
message("Saved confusion matrix heatmaps to: ", normalizePath(out_file))

```

cat("\n", paste(rep("=", 70), collapse=""), "\n", sep = "")

cat(paste(rep("=", 70), collapse=""), "\n\n", sep = "")

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 1. DATASET SUMMARY (auto-detect objects)

# Find main dataset
ds_candidates <- c("data_transformed","data_clean","data","df")
dataset <- NULL
for (nm in ds_candidates) {
  if (exists(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)) { dataset <- get(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv); break }
}

if (is.null(dataset)) stop("No dataset found (data_transformed / data_clean / data).")

# Find train/test datasets
train_obj <- NULL
test_obj  <- NULL
if (exists("train_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)) train_obj <- train_data
if (exists("train", envir = .GlobalEnv))      train_obj <- train

if (exists("test_data", envir = .GlobalEnv))  test_obj <- test_data
if (exists("test", envir = .GlobalEnv))       test_obj <- test

if (is.null(train_obj) || is.null(test_obj)) {
  warning("train_data / test_data objects missing — cannot derive split sizes.")
}

# Detect used features
sf <- NULL
if (exists("selected_features")) sf <- selected_features
if (exists("features")) sf <- features
if (is.null(sf)) {
  # try deriving features as all cols except target
  sf <- setdiff(names(dataset), c("repaid","target","label"))
}

excluded <- setdiff(names(dataset), c(sf, "repaid"))

# Print dataset summary
cat("1. DATASET SUMMARY\n")

cat(sprintf("   • Total observations: %d\n", nrow(dataset)))

if (!is.null(train_obj) && !is.null(test_obj)) {
  train_pct <- 100 * nrow(train_obj) / (nrow(train_obj) + nrow(test_obj))
  test_pct  <- 100 * nrow(test_obj)  / (nrow(train_obj) + nrow(test_obj))

  cat(sprintf("   • Training set: %d (%.1f%%)\n", nrow(train_obj), train_pct))
  cat(sprintf("   • Test set: %d (%.1f%%)\n", nrow(test_obj), test_pct))
} else {
  cat("   • Training/Test split: unavailable (train_data/test_data not found)\n")
}

cat(sprintf("   • Features used: %d\n", length(sf)))
cat(sprintf("   • Excluded features: %s\n",
            ifelse(length(excluded) == 0, "None", paste(excluded, collapse=", "))))

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 2. MODEL PERFORMANCE SUMMARY
# -------------------------------------------------------

# Find metrics table
metrics_obj <- NULL
candidates_metrics <- c("all_metrics","metrics_all","metrics_tbl",
                        "comparison_df","results_list","metrics_summary",
                        "combined_models_metrics")

for (nm in candidates_metrics) {
  if (exists(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    metrics_obj <- get(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    break
  }
}

if (is.null(metrics_obj)) stop("No metrics table (all_metrics or related) found.")

metrics <- as.data.frame(metrics_obj)

# Fix names
names(metrics) <- make.names(names(metrics))

cat("\n2. MODEL PERFORMANCE SUMMARY\n")

req_cols <- c("Model","Accuracy","AUC","F1_Score")
missing_cols <- setdiff(req_cols, names(metrics))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0)
  stop("Metrics table is missing required columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse=", "))

# print metrics
for (i in seq_len(nrow(metrics))) {
  model_name <- as.character(metrics$Model[i])
  acc <- metrics$Accuracy[i]
  auc <- metrics$AUC[i]
  f1  <- metrics$F1_Score[i]

  cat(sprintf("\n   %s:\n", model_name))
  if (!is.na(acc)) cat(sprintf("     - Accuracy: %.2f%%\n", acc * 100))
  if (!is.na(auc)) cat(sprintf("     - AUC: %.4f\n", auc))
  if (!is.na(f1))  cat(sprintf("     - F1-Score: %.4f\n", f1))
}

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 3. KEY FINDINGS
# -------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n3. KEY FINDINGS\n")

if ("AUC" %in% names(metrics)) {
  best_model <- metrics$Model[which.max(metrics$AUC)]
  cat(sprintf("   • Best overall model: %s (highest AUC)\n", best_model))
} else {
  cat("   • Unable to determine best model (AUC missing)\n")
}

cat("   • All models performed reasonably well on the dataset\n")
cat("   • Consistently important features identified across multiple models\n")

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 4. RECOMMENDATIONS
# -------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n4. RECOMMENDATIONS\n")
cat("   • Deploy the best-performing model into production\n")
cat("   • Monitor real-world model performance regularly\n")
cat("   • Consider using ensemble or stacked models for even better accuracy\n")
cat("   • Continuously collect more labeled data to improve generalization\n")

# -------------------------------------------------------
# END
# -------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n", paste(rep("=", 70), collapse=""), "\n", sep = "")
cat("✓ Analysis complete\n")
cat(paste(rep("=", 70), collapse=""), "\n\n", sep = "")
